chains.name: 氦气
chains.header: 氦气 — 霍尔木兹
chains.份额: 卡塔尔约 36%（约 64 MCM），美国约 45%，两国合计约 81%（C3，美国地质调查局 2025 年两份报告）。卡塔尔那部分全部经 Ras Laffan 港装船出海。
chains.下游: 核磁共振机（全球约 15 万台，每台年耗液氦 700–1500 升）、半导体光刻的光路保护气、光纤拉丝、量子计算与粒子加速器、导弹导引头与卫星传感器的低温冷却。
chains.停摆窗口: 即时型。核磁共振机补货 2–8 周，无替代冷却剂（C3）。
chains.重建时间: 新建液化厂 3–5 年，新气田 5–10 年，坦桑尼亚新产地估计 10 年以上（C2–C3）。美国联邦储备 2024-01-25 已整体售出，价格缓冲机制终止（C4）。
chains.价格弹性: 2026 年现货涨 70–100%（二手来源，待核）。
chains.对谁而言: 签了长期合同的买家与只能买现货的买家差别很大——医院与小型研究机构没有长约保护，最先受冲击。
chains.显式豁免: 无。氦气目前属美国出口管制里最宽松的一级（EAR99），管制选项存在但未激活（C2）。
chains.header_en: Helium — Hormuz
chains.停摆窗口_en: Immediate. MRI restocking takes 2–8 weeks, with no substitute coolant (C3).
chains.下游_en: MRI machines (about 150,000 worldwide, each using 700–1500 liters of liquid helium a year), purge gas for the optical path in semiconductor lithography, optical-fiber drawing, quantum computing and particle accelerators, cryogenic cooling of missile seekers and satellite sensors.
chains.重建时间_en: A new liquefaction plant 3–5 years, a new gas field 5–10 years, the new Tanzanian source an estimated 10 years or more (C2–C3). The US Federal Helium Reserve was sold off in its entirety on 2024-01-25, ending the price-buffer mechanism (C4).
chains.价格弹性_en: 2026 spot up 70–100% (second-hand source, awaiting checking).
chains.对谁而言_en: A large gap between buyers with long-term contracts and those who can only buy spot; hospitals and small research institutions have no long-contract protection and are hit first.

chains.name: 液化天然气
chains.header: 液化天然气 — 霍尔木兹（供给侧）与乌克兰（需求侧）
chains.份额: 2023 年全球贸易量 404 MT（C4，壳牌 LNG 展望 2024）；卡塔尔约 77–80 MT、约 19–20%，澳大利亚约 20%，美国 86 MT（C3–C4）。前三家合计约 57–60%。
chains.下游: 发电（全球发电量约 22–23% 靠天然气，日本约 33%）、工业供热、欧洲约 40% 家庭取暖、以及氮肥的原料。
chains.停摆窗口: 即时型，但有储气缓冲。欧洲储气库约 100 BCM，注入与提取有速率限制，不能像石油储备那样随时释放。
chains.重建时间: 新液化项目从投资决定到投产 5–7 年；新建陆上接收站 3–5 年；把现役船改成浮式再气化装置最快 12–18 个月；新造运输船交期 3–4 年（C2–C3）。
chains.价格弹性: 2022 年 8 月欧洲现货价峰值约 342 欧元每兆瓦时，是平时的十倍以上（C3）。
chains.对谁而言: 这一栏最关键。 欧洲 2022 年确实完成了替代，但条件是价格涨五到十倍、额外支出约一到二万亿欧元、需求压缩约 15%，加上那年冬天偏暖。同一个卡点，对富裕经济体是“很贵”，对付不起十倍溢价的中低收入经济体则接近于关闭。
chains.显式豁免: 俄罗斯的 Arctic LNG 2 被欧盟第十二轮制裁指定，而 Yamal LNG 刻意未被制裁（道达尔持股 20%）——这说明不制裁某一处，常常是因为制裁方自己也在其中。
chains.header_en: LNG — Hormuz (supply side) and Ukraine (demand side)
chains.停摆窗口_en: Immediate but with a gas-storage buffer. European storage holds about 100 BCM, injection and withdrawal are rate-limited, and it cannot be released at will the way oil stocks can.
chains.下游_en: Power generation (about 22–23% of world electricity comes from gas, Japan about 33%), industrial heat, about 40% of European household heating, and the feedstock for nitrogen fertilizer.
chains.重建时间_en: A new liquefaction project takes 5–7 years from investment decision to start-up; a new onshore receiving terminal 3–5 years; converting an existing ship into a floating regasification unit 12–18 months at the fastest; a newbuild carrier 3–4 years to delivery (C2–C3).
chains.价格弹性_en: In August 2022 the European spot price peaked at about 342 euros per MWh, more than ten times normal (C3).
chains.对谁而言_en: The most important column of this chain. Europe did complete substitution in 2022, but on condition of prices rising five to ten times, extra spending of about one to two trillion euros, demand compressed by about 15%, and a mild winter that year. The same chokepoint is "very expensive" for rich economies and "nearly closed" for lower- and middle-income economies that cannot pay a tenfold premium.

chains.name: 氮肥
chains.header: 氮肥 — 两个案例同时压在它上面
chains.份额: 俄罗斯占全球氮肥出口 15–20%，是最大单一出口国（C3）；中国占全球合成氨产能 30–35%（主要内销，出口靠配额管理，C3）；中东（卡塔尔、沙特）约 10–12%，卡塔尔 QAFCO 是全球最大单体尿素工厂群（C3）。
chains.下游: 全球谷物产量。约 55–60% 的氮肥用于谷物（C2）。
chains.停摆窗口: 滞后型，这条链与别的不同。 库存缓冲 30–60 天，但农业有购肥窗口，错过就是一整季；一季减施，下一季单产降 30–50%（C2）。它影响的不是今天的贸易量，而是四到八个月后的收成。
chains.重建时间: 新建大型氨厂 3–5 年、投资 15–25 亿美元（C2）；现有工厂挖潜 6–18 个月。绿氨路线要到 2030 年代。
chains.价格弹性: 2022 年初尿素峰值约 850–900 美元每吨，约为 2020 年基准的四倍（C3）。2021 年中国收缩出口配额时，两个月内从约 250 涨到约 550–600（C3）。
chains.对谁而言: 发展中国家农民先减施，因为外汇与利润率都薄。
chains.显式豁免: 有，而且是本表最明确的一条政治证据。 2022 年对俄制裁是历史上力度最大的一轮，美国财政部在同一框架下签发通用许可，明确豁免化肥交易（C4，许可编号待核）；联合国 2022-07-22 黑海谷物协议里专门写入恢复俄罗斯化肥与氨出口的条款（C3）。从制裁推出到豁免明确约三到四周。
chains.header_en: Nitrogen fertilizer — both cases rest on it at once
chains.停摆窗口_en: Lagged; this chain differs from the others. Inventory buffers 30–60 days, but farming has a fertilizer-buying window, and missing it means a whole season; one season of reduced application cuts the next season's yield by 30–50% (C2). So what it affects is not today's trade volume but the harvest four to eight months later.
chains.下游_en: World grain output. About 55–60% of nitrogen fertilizer goes to grain (C2).
chains.重建时间_en: A new large ammonia plant 3–5 years and an investment of USD 1.5–2.5 billion (C2); squeezing more from existing plants 6–18 months. The green-ammonia route not before the 2030s.
chains.价格弹性_en: In early 2022 urea peaked at about USD 850–900 per tonne, about four times the 2020 baseline (C3). When China tightened export quotas in 2021, it rose from about 250 to about 550–600 within two months (C3).
chains.对谁而言_en: Farmers in developing countries cut application first, because both foreign exchange and margins are thin.

chains.name: 原油
chains.header: 原油 — 霍尔木兹（供给与运输）、乌克兰（制裁与折扣）
chains.份额: 全球产量约 100–102 mb/d（C4，美国能源信息署）；美国约 13%、沙特约 10–12 mb/d、俄罗斯约 9.5–10.5 mb/d，OPEC+ 合计约 40–45%（C3）。中东已探明储量约占全球 48%（C3）。生产集中度不等于定价集中度——真正的定价方是沙特，凭的是全球唯一有实质意义的摇摆产能。
chains.下游: 交通（公路汽柴油约 45–50 mb/d 等价、航空约 2.5 mb/d、海运船用油约 4–5 mb/d）、石化原料（约 10–15 mb/d）、部分地区发电。
chains.停摆窗口: 即时型，缓冲 30–60 天。大型炼厂一般维持这么多天的原油库存，断供要一到两个月才传导到成品油紧张。
chains.重建时间: 新常规油田从批准到投产 5–7 年；美国页岩钻井到出油 3–6 个月，是现有供给里最快的增产机制。
chains.价格弹性: 1973 年那次，约 5% 的供给减少让油价在六个月里涨了约四倍（C3）。这是本表可用的历史标尺——短期需求弹性很低时，很小的供给缺口也会带来极大的价格反应。
chains.对谁而言: 制裁下的俄罗斯原油以折扣卖给印度、中国、土耳其，折扣约 10–20 美元每桶（C3）；买方获益、卖方损失收入，但物量没有断。
chains.显式豁免: 价格上限机制本身就是“允许物流、只压收入”的设计——历史上第一次明文允许被制裁方的商品继续在全球流通。
chains.header_en: Crude oil — Hormuz (supply and transport), Ukraine (sanctions and discounts)
chains.停摆窗口_en: Immediate, buffer 30–60 days. Large refineries usually hold that many days of crude, so a supply cut takes one to two months to reach product tightness.
chains.下游_en: Transport (road gasoline and diesel about 45–50 mb/d equivalent, aviation about 2.5 mb/d, marine bunkers about 4–5 mb/d), petrochemical feedstock (about 10–15 mb/d), power generation in some regions.
chains.重建时间_en: A new conventional oil field 5–7 years from approval to production; US shale 3–6 months from drilling to oil, the fastest supply-increase mechanism in the existing system.
chains.价格弹性_en: In 1973 a supply loss of about 5% raised the oil price about fourfold within six months (C3). This is the historical yardstick available to this table: when short-run demand elasticity is very low, a very small supply gap can produce a very large price response.
chains.对谁而言_en: Russian crude under sanctions sells at a discount to India, China and Turkey, about USD 10–20 per barrel (C3); buyers gain, the seller loses revenue, but the physical volume is not cut.

chains.name: 油轮航路
chains.header: 油轮航路 — 霍尔木兹（本表与这个案例关系最直接的一条）
chains.份额: 霍尔木兹日过境约 20–21 mb/d，约占全球石油产量 20%（C4，美国能源信息署）。其余通道：马六甲约 15–16、曼德海峡约 6–8、苏伊士约 5–6、土耳其海峡约 2–3 mb/d（C3）。船队本身是分散的（全球超大型油轮约 860 艘，前四大运营商合计约 15–20%，无定价方），集中的是通道和制度。
chains.下游: 亚洲炼厂合计进口约 25–28 mb/d（C3）。中国约 70% 的进口原油要经马六甲，这就是中国所说“马六甲困境”的来源。
chains.停摆窗口: 即时型，缓冲 30–60 天炼厂库存加上各国战略储备（国际能源署成员合计约 12–15 亿桶，约合全球 35–45 天消费，C3）。
chains.重建时间: 绕行能力有硬上限，不能靠购买迅速增加。沙特东西向管道约 4.8 mb/d（C4，沙特石油公司官方）加阿联酋富查伊拉管道约 1.5 mb/d，合计 6–7 mb/d；霍尔木兹过境是 20 mb/d，剩下的 13–14 mb/d（伊拉克、科威特、伊朗、卡塔尔的出口）没有任何地面替代路径。节点判定：这是全图能源节点中替代覆盖率最低的一个地理单点。新建伊拉克出海管道要 30–50 亿美元加 5–7 年（C2）。
chains.价格弹性: 完全封锁没有历史先例，各机构情景估算油价 150–250 美元每桶（C2，无单一权威原文，当估算用不当事实用）。有先例的是红海：2023 年 10 月起胡塞武装袭击后，绕好望角多走约 14 天、船运成本增加约 50–100%（C3）。
chains.对谁而言: 分市场。制度这一层对欧美有效、对印中基本无效（见下）。
chains.显式豁免: 价格上限本身即“允许物流、只压收入”的设计（见第 6 条原油）。
chains.header_en: Tanker routes — Hormuz (the chain in this table most directly tied to this case)
chains.停摆窗口_en: Immediate, buffer of 30–60 days of refinery stocks plus national strategic reserves (IEA members together about 1.2–1.5 billion barrels, roughly 35–45 days of world consumption, C3).
chains.下游_en: Asian refineries together import about 25–28 mb/d (C3). About 70% of China's imported crude passes Malacca (C3), the source of its own phrase "the Malacca dilemma".
chains.重建时间_en: Bypass capacity is a hard ceiling that cannot be bought. The Saudi East-West pipeline about 4.8 mb/d (C4, Saudi Aramco official) plus the UAE Fujairah pipeline about 1.5 mb/d, 6–7 mb/d in all; Hormuz transit is 20 mb/d, and the remaining 13–14 mb/d (exports of Iraq, Kuwait, Iran and Qatar) has no overland substitute at all. Node judgment: this is the single geographic point with the lowest substitute coverage among all energy nodes on the map. A new Iraqi pipeline to the sea would take USD 3–5 billion and 5–7 years (C2).
chains.价格弹性_en: A full blockade has no historical precedent; institutional scenarios put the oil price at USD 150–250 per barrel (C2, no single authoritative source; use as an estimate, not a fact). The precedent that exists is the Red Sea: after the Houthi attacks from October 2023, going round the Cape of Good Hope added about 14 days and raised shipping costs about 50–100% (C3).
chains.对谁而言_en: By market. The institutional layer works on Europe and the US and largely not on India and China (see below).

chains.name: 炼化
chains.header: 炼化 — 乌克兰俄罗斯（制裁与洗白通道），霍尔木兹（亚洲炼厂的进料端）
chains.份额: 全球炼能为 103,756 千桶/日（2025，C4，EI《世界能源统计评论 2026》）；中国占 18.1%，居首，美国占 17.5%，俄罗斯占 6.5%，印度占 4.7%。按公司计算，最大的 ExxonMobil 也只占约 5%。没有哪家公司能够定价，炼厂在原油和成品油两端都是价格接受者，赚的是 5–15 美元/桶的加工价差（C3）。与案例直接相关的是柴油下游：战前俄罗斯占欧盟柴油进口的 40%（月均 200 万吨），2023-02 禁令后降至 2%（C3–C4，Eurostat）。
chains.下游: 交通运输，汽油、柴油、航空煤油是成品油的主要去向。欧洲长期缺柴油，必须进口；正因如此，“俄油在第三国炼成成品油再进欧盟”的洗白通道才有市场。
chains.停摆窗口: 即时型，而且比原油更快。成品油库存通常只有数周，原油端则有 30–60 天；一旦断供，影响传到加油站的速度更快（C2）。
chains.重建时间: 新建炼厂需要 4–5 年，投资额在百亿美元以上；炼型切换，即更换适用的原油品质，需要停车改造，按月计算。2022 年欧洲弃用乌拉尔原油，实测用了数月（C3）。
chains.价格弹性: 这条链没有单一商品价格，关键是裂解价差，即成品油卖价与原油买价之间的差额。历史区间为 5–15 美元/桶。2022 年战争首年，全球裂解价差上升，Reliance O2C 分部 EBITDA 一年增长 17.7%（C4 五年序列）。同一序列也给出反向证据：FY25 俄油折价仍在，裂解价差却跌了 36–41%，毛利下降 11.9%。炼化毛利主要由全球裂解价差周期决定，俄油折价只是附加因素。因此，制裁即使压低折价，能够打掉的利润也有上限；这个上限取决于制裁方无法控制的全球裂解价差。
chains.对谁而言: 分三层看。被点名的单厂 Nayara 受到的即时冲击很大：买家拒收，进料一度降至约四分之一；但 60 天后恢复，原因是印度国有银行出面搭建卢比结算（C3）。欧盟承担进口溢价，俄罗斯损失的是单位收入，不是物量。
chains.显式豁免: 有，而且比氮肥那条更制度化。 Art. 3ma 设有两个默认放行渠道（C4 法律原文）：Annex LI 中九个伙伴国享有零举证豁免；“净出口国推定”则规定，上一年为原油净出口国的第三国，其出口的成品油默认推定并非由俄油炼成，覆盖约 80 国。欧委会 FAQ 第 6 题直接说明原因：避免过度合规损害欧盟自身的供应安全。跨链发现八，即豁免可以事前推断，在这里再次得到验证；而且这里的豁免不只是逐案签发的许可，而是“默认放行、例外收紧”的分级制度。
chains.header_en: Refining — Ukraine/Russia (sanctions and laundering channel), Hormuz (feedstock side of Asian refineries)
chains.停摆窗口_en: Immediate, and faster than crude: product inventories are only weeks (against 30–60 days on the crude side), so a cut-off reaches the filling station one notch faster (C2).
chains.下游_en: Transport (gasoline, diesel and jet fuel are the main product downstream). The most politicized chain is Europe's structural diesel shortage and need to import, which is the basic reason the "Russian crude refined into products in a third country and then into the EU" laundering channel has a market.
chains.重建时间_en: A new refinery 4–5 years and over ten billion dollars; switching crude slate requires a shutdown and modification measured in months; Europe's abandonment of Urals crude in 2022 took months in practice (C3).
chains.价格弹性_en: This chain's price is not a single commodity price but the crack spread (the gap between product selling price and crude buying price). Historical range USD 5–15/bbl; in 2022, the first war year, global crack spreads rose and Reliance's O2C segment EBITDA rose 17.7% in a year (C4, five-year series). The same series gives the more important reverse evidence: in FY25 the Russian discount was still there, crack spreads fell 36–41%, and gross margin fell 11.9%; the dominant variable in refining margin is the global crack-spread cycle, and the Russian discount is only an overlay. So the profit sanctions can remove by squeezing the discount has a ceiling, set by a variable the sanctioning side does not control.
chains.对谁而言_en: Three layers. The named single refinery (Nayara) took a sharp immediate hit, buyers refused cargoes and throughput once fell to about a quarter, but recovered in 60 days thanks to an Indian state bank stepping in to set up rupee settlement (C3); the EU pays its own import premium; what Russia loses is unit revenue, not volume.

chains.name: 锗
chains.header: 锗 —（边缘收录：不经过两案例的任何必经点，收录理由见下）
chains.份额: 中国初级锗约占 60%（区间 59–68%，C2 软数字——USGS 明确不为任何百分比背书，这与镓的 99% 硬数字有根本差别）；按对美供给的合并口径，比利时以 41% 居首，中国为 23%；美国净进口依赖 >50%，不是 100%（C4）。
chains.下游: 光纤掺杂，是美国第一大用途，也是海底光缆纤芯的上游，与第 14 条相连；此外还有军用红外热成像和卫星多结太阳能电池衬底，后者是最接近真正卡死的窄应用。
chains.停摆窗口: 这条链表现为涨价型，不是断供型。2024-12 对美禁令后，美国锗金属进口下降 67%；但光纤使用的二氧化锗由比利时、加拿大补上，进口反而增长 55%，原因是抢购和囤货。美国国防后勤局还有库存缓冲。价格会立即上涨，换料认证则要按年计算。
chains.重建时间: 回收层已在即时运转，Umicore 超过一半原料来自回收（C3）；非中国初级产能扩张需要数年，例如 Teck Trail 的锗产量翻倍计划，以及加拿大政府在 2026-07 承诺的最高 4 亿加元注资（C2）。
chains.价格弹性: 禁令实施一年后，锗金属年均价从 $1,991 涨至 $4,100，翻了一倍；欧洲现货价格在 2025 年 1–10 月从 $3,150 升至 $5,380（C4，USGS）。锗的替代性更高、集中度更低，价格反应却比镓更猛烈，原因在于中国出口总量确实在收缩：2023→2025 年 1–9 月出口量为 36,656→18,787→7,520 kg，连续腰斩。量真的减少，价格就真的上涨。
chains.对谁而言: 美国红外光学和锗晶片进口商最先受冲击，即金属线进口下降 67% 的那一端；光纤线依靠第三国供给维持下来，代价是抢购和涨价。
chains.显式豁免: 形态特殊。它不是对特定对象豁免，而是整包暂停、军用条款保留：72 号公告将对美“原则上不予许可”暂停至 2026-11-27，但对美军事用途的禁令，即 46 号第一款，从未放松。恢复只需商务部发布一纸公告，这与西方扩产需要数年的时间尺度并不对称。
chains.header_en: Germanium — (marginal entry: passes through no chokepoint of either case; reason for inclusion below)
chains.停摆窗口_en: This chain is of the price-rise type, not the cut-off type. After the 2024-12 ban on the US, US imports of germanium metal fell 67%, but germanium dioxide (for optical fiber) held up via Belgium and Canada and actually rose 55% (panic buying and stockpiling); the US Defense Logistics Agency has a stockpile as a floor. The price rise is immediate; requalifying a substitute material takes years.
chains.下游_en: Optical-fiber doping (the top US use, upstream of submarine-cable fiber cores, linked to no. 14), military infrared thermal imaging, substrates for multi-junction satellite solar cells (the narrow application closest to being choked).
chains.重建时间_en: The recycling layer is already running (over half of Umicore's feed comes from recycling, C3); expanding non-Chinese primary capacity takes years (Teck Trail's plan to double germanium output, Canadian government funding of up to CAD 400 million, 2026-07, C2).
chains.价格弹性_en: One year into the ban, the annual average germanium metal price went from $1,991 to $4,100, a doubling; the European spot price rose from $3,150 to $5,380 between January and October 2025 (C4, USGS). A more substitutable, less concentrated commodity showed a sharper price response than gallium, because Chinese exports contracted in total (36,656→18,787→7,520 kg over January–September of 2023→2025, halved and halved again): the volume really fell, so the price really rose.
chains.对谁而言_en: US infrared-optics and germanium-wafer importers are hit first (the metal line, down 67%); the fiber line holds up through third countries, at the cost of panic buying and higher prices.

chains.name: 海底光缆
chains.header: 海底光缆 — 乌克兰俄罗斯（波罗的海 Eagle S 案，C4 判决），霍尔木兹（节点无专门数据，红海是同型相邻样本）
chains.份额: 全球约 97% 的国际互联网流量经海底光缆传输（C4），但这条链不是单点：全球有 400 多条活跃光缆，几十条主干路由并行。真正集中的，是地理走廊。红海承载欧亚之间约 80–90% 的光缆（C3），台湾有约 14 条光缆登陆。卡点的触发条件不是一条缆被切断，而是同一走廊多条缆同时受损。
chains.下游: 所有跨境互联网流量，包括跨境金融报文的物理承载；SWIFT、CHIPS 清算指令都经过这条管道，跨境 AI 算力调度也依赖它。
chains.停摆窗口: 即时型，没有任何库存缓冲。路由切换只需分钟，带宽损失立刻出现。2024 年红海四条光缆受损后，欧亚流量绕行好望角，延迟增加约 100–150ms，但没有断网（C3）。单缆国家则不同：汤加在 2022 年断缆后，依靠卫星维持基本通信约 5 周。
chains.重建时间: 深海修复需要数周至 3 个月，但节点内的实测数据把这个时间拆开了（C3，SubOptic 2013，五个维护区 471 次修复统计）：技术上的出航准备可在 24 小时内完成；把修复拖到按月计算的，是沿岸国修复许可，中国、意大利、印尼的延迟最突出，英国没有许可制，因此没有这类延迟，以及战区安全，红海排队为 3–6 个月。 新建洲际光缆则需 3–5 年。
chains.价格弹性: 不适用。代价表现为延迟和带宽下降，而且代价高度分散，没有直接付费者。地理集中点上没有人向过路光缆收费，因此这是一种纯粹的脆弱性，不产生政治租金；这与霍尔木兹的伊朗、苏伊士的埃及不同。
chains.对谁而言: 按冗余程度分层。主干路由的用户感受到的是延迟；只有单缆或少缆地区才会真正断网。对两个案例而言，波罗的海的乌俄侧光缆较少，且已有实际案件；波斯湾内光缆的走廊数据，节点中没有，是一个缺口。
chains.显式豁免: 没有豁免概念，但有一条相反的事实必须记下：法律保护实际上无力。 UNCLOS 第 113 条明文保护海缆，却没有执法机制。Eagle S 案中，赫尔辛基地方法院在 2025-10-03 的 C4 判决要点里，将过失断缆定性为“航行事故”；刑事管辖只归船旗国或被告国籍国。芬兰对发生在本国专属经济区、损害落在本国的断缆没有管辖权，起诉被驳回。
chains.header_en: Submarine cables — Ukraine/Russia (the Baltic Eagle S case, C4 judgment), Hormuz (no dedicated data in the node; the Red Sea is the adjacent sample of the same type)
chains.停摆窗口_en: Immediate with no inventory buffer at all: route switching is a matter of minutes and bandwidth loss is instant. Measured in 2024 when four Red Sea cables were damaged: Europe-Asia traffic detoured via Cape Town, latency rose about 100–150 ms, no outage (C3). Single-cable countries are another matter: after its 2022 cable break Tonga kept basic communications by satellite for about 5 weeks.
chains.下游_en: All cross-border internet, including the physical carriage of cross-border financial messages (SWIFT and CHIPS clearing instructions all go through this pipe) and cross-border AI compute scheduling.
chains.重建时间_en: Deep-sea repair weeks to 3 months, but that number is broken down by the node's measured data (C3, SubOptic 2013, statistics on 471 repairs across five maintenance zones): technical sailing preparation is complete within 24 hours; what drags repair out to months is coastal-state repair permits (delays most pronounced in China, Italy and Indonesia; the UK has no permit system and no such delay) and war-zone security (a 3–6 month queue in the Red Sea). A new intercontinental cable 3–5 years.
chains.价格弹性_en: Not applicable. The cost takes the form of latency and bandwidth degradation, highly dispersed with no direct payer; nobody at the geographic chokepoint charges passing cables, so it is pure vulnerability that yields no political rent (unlike Iran at Hormuz or Egypt at Suez).
chains.对谁而言_en: Stratified by redundancy. Users on trunk routes perceive latency; single- or few-cable regions get real outages. For the two cases: the Baltic (Ukraine/Russia side) has few cables and an actual case already; for cables inside the Persian Gulf the node has no corridor data, a gap.

chains.name: 集装箱航运
chains.header: 集装箱航运 — 两案例的必经点节点内无专门数字（波斯湾枢纽港、黑海航线均缺），红海绕行与美东罢工是同型实测样本
chains.份额: 要分三层看，三层结构不同。承运人层是分散寡头：前十家合计占 84%，前三家，即 MSC 20%、马士基 14%、达飞 12%，合计 46%（C4，联合国贸发会议 2025 年海运述评，2025 年 4 月口径）。联盟层才集中：远东—欧洲主干航线三大联盟合计约占 82%，其中 Ocean Alliance 一家占 39%（C4）。岸桥，即把箱子吊上吊下的专用起重机，则接近独占：上海振华占全球约 70%，占美国在用设备约 80%（C4，美国众议院两委员会联合报告）。承运人的法域真正分散，瑞士、丹麦、法国、中国、德国、日本、台湾、韩国、以色列都有主力玩家。
chains.下游: 2024 年全球约有 26 亿标准箱流动（C4），几乎涵盖所有制成品和零部件的跨境运输。下游库存只有在库和在途的数周，没有可释放的战略储备；能源可以储备，杂货物流不能。
chains.停摆窗口: 即时型。2024 年 10 月美东码头工人罢工三天，估算每天冲击约 50 亿美元（C3）。
chains.重建时间: 新船需要 2–3 年，产能集中于中韩，中国占全球造船订单的 63.7%（C4）。枢纽港的地位依靠数十年的航线网络和腹地连接积累，不能迅速复制；联盟本身约一年即可重组，例如 2M 解散后 Gemini 形成，组织形态是流动的。
chains.价格弹性: 红海危机的实测数据表明，2024 年初约 80% 的集装箱运量改道好望角，上海—欧洲现货运费一度达到正常水平的 3–4 倍（C3，Drewry）。
chains.对谁而言: 应按链条的运行结构区分，不按国家区分。面对同一条红海，油轮改道意味着多走十四天、多烧油；集装箱改道则会打乱整个枢纽轮转体系。班期刚性使绕行的系统代价更高，2025 年初联盟重组直接造成安特卫普、汉堡、鹿特丹连续拥堵。
chains.显式豁免: 无。
chains.header_en: Container shipping — no dedicated figures in the node for either case's chokepoints (Gulf hub ports and Black Sea routes both missing); the Red Sea detour and the US East Coast strike are measured samples of the same type
chains.停摆窗口_en: Immediate. The three-day US East Coast dockworkers' strike of October 2024 was estimated at about USD 5 billion a day (C3).
chains.下游_en: About 2.6 billion TEU a year worldwide (2024, C4), the cross-border movement of almost all manufactured goods and components. Downstream inventory is only the weeks in stock and in transit, with no strategic reserve to release: energy can be stockpiled, general-cargo logistics cannot.
chains.重建时间_en: New ships 2–3 years (capacity concentrated in China and Korea, China holding 63.7% of world shipbuilding orders, C4); hub-port status rests on decades of route networks and hinterland connections and cannot be copied quickly; alliances themselves can regroup in about a year (from the 2M breakup to the formation of Gemini), so the organizational form is fluid.
chains.价格弹性_en: Measured in the Red Sea crisis: in early 2024 about 80% of container volume diverted round the Cape of Good Hope, and Shanghai–Europe spot rates were at one point 3–4 times normal (C3, Drewry).
chains.对谁而言_en: By the chain's operating structure, not by country. In the same Red Sea, a tanker detour means fourteen more days and more fuel; a container detour disrupts the whole hub rotation system, and schedule rigidity makes the systemic cost of rerouting one notch higher (the early-2025 alliance reshuffle directly caused chain congestion at Antwerp, Hamburg and Rotterdam).

chains.name: 液化天然气运输船
chains.header: 液化天然气运输船 — 霍尔木兹（费率实测直接可用），乌克兰俄罗斯（围护技术切断实证）
chains.份额: 三层结构相反。船东层分散，现役 804 艘船分布在几十家、多法域企业中，包括卡塔尔、希腊、日本、挪威、马来西亚、中国，没有谁能决定运力方向（C4，国际燃气联盟 2026 年报告）。建造层由韩国前三，即 HD 现代、三星重工、韩华海洋，加上正在上升的中国构成；除沪东中华外，还有四家新进入船厂合计在建 28 艘（C4）。真正近乎独占的，是最不起眼的一层：法国 GTT 公司的薄膜围护系统，即货舱低温绝热技术，受专利保护。2015–2024 年新造的 578 艘船中，566 艘采用它的设计，覆盖 97.9%（C4，GTT 年度注册文件）。中国建造的船同样需要向它购买授权。
chains.下游: 2025 年全球 437 百万吨液化天然气贸易（C4）全部依赖这种船舶海运，没有替代运输方式。欧洲进口 126 百万吨，中国约 70 百万吨，日韩合计约 130 百万吨。它与第 3 条，即液化天然气商品，是同一条链的运输端和商品端。
chains.停摆窗口: 即时型。进口国储罐通常只够数周，液化天然气不能像原油一样大规模储备，因为需要低温保存，而且会发生蒸发损耗。
chains.重建时间: 新船需要 2–3 年，301 艘订单已排至 2031 年，运力弹性受船坞产能限制。围护专利的替代则要按十年计算：韩国唯一挑战者投入十几年，仍只获得极小份额；船东和船级社的信任积累不能直接购买。
chains.价格弹性: 这是本表已有实测中最大的费率反应。2026 年霍尔木兹危机期间，苏伊士以东的即期租船费率从 2 月初约 14,250 美元每天，上升到 3 月 5 日 30 万美元每天的峰值，约为二十倍（C4）。必须同时记住背景：2025 年全年费率处于历史低位，市场运力过剩。
chains.对谁而言: 危机费率冲击租船货主和进口国；制裁切断则冲击被点名项目。俄罗斯 Arctic LNG 2 订购的 21 艘破冰型运输船中，只有 2 艘赶在西方技术撤出前装上围护系统，其余船壳留在船坞，缺少货舱技术（C4）。
chains.显式豁免: 没有豁免，但有缓冲窗口。美国财政部的一般许可允许既有合同履行至 2024-01-31，欧盟条例设有截至 2024-09-26 的过渡期。这是发现十一所说“已发布未生效”中间状态的又一例。
chains.header_en: LNG carriers — Hormuz (measured charter rates directly usable), Ukraine/Russia (measured evidence of containment-technology cut-off)
chains.停摆窗口_en: Immediate. Importers' tanks usually hold only weeks, and LNG cannot be stockpiled on the scale of crude (cryogenic, with boil-off losses).
chains.下游_en: World LNG trade of 437 million tonnes in 2025 (C4) moves entirely on these ships, with no alternative mode of transport. Europe imports 126 million tonnes, China about 70, Japan and Korea together about 130. With no. 3 (the LNG commodity) it is the commodity end and the transport end of the same chain.
chains.重建时间_en: New ships 2–3 years, an order book of 301 ships stretching to 2031, with capacity elasticity physically limited by yard capacity; a substitute for the containment patents takes decades; Korea's only challenger spent over ten years to win a tiny share, and the trust of owners and classification societies cannot be bought.
chains.价格弹性_en: The largest rate response this table has measured. In the 2026 Hormuz crisis, east-of-Suez spot charter rates rose from about USD 14,250 a day in early February to a peak of USD 300,000 a day on 5 March, about twentyfold (C4). The background must be recorded with it: rates through 2025 were at historic lows with surplus capacity.
chains.对谁而言_en: Crisis rates hit charterers and importing countries; sanctions cut-offs hit named projects: of the 21 ice-class carriers ordered for Russia's Arctic LNG 2, only 2 got their containment systems fitted before Western technology withdrew, and the rest sit in the yards as hulls without cargo-tank technology (C4).

chains.name: SWIFT 跨境银行报文网络
chains.header: SWIFT 跨境银行报文网络 — 乌克兰俄罗斯（2022 断连），伊朗（2012、2018 两次断连，是伊朗案例的直接材料）
chains.份额: 跨境银行间标准报文约 90% 以上（C3，广泛报道、无官方份额数），覆盖约 11,000 家机构和 200 多个国家。机构本身营收约 8–10 亿欧元（C2–C3，成本回收型合作社），承载的支付指令价值以千万亿美元每年计算，营收与杠杆相差百万倍（C2 推算）。先纠正一个常见错读：SWIFT 不结算，也不持有钱；它只传递“请把钱从 A 付给 B”的标准指令。 断开 SWIFT 不是冻结资金，而是让一家银行无法接入标准网络。
chains.下游: 本表每一条链的钱那一面都从这里通过，包括信用证、代理行支付和大宗商品结算的指令端。
chains.停摆窗口: 这是全表执行最快的开关。断连是数据库操作，欧盟条例生效后数小时内即可完成。2022 年从开战（02-24）到首批俄罗斯银行断连（03-02），不到两周。
chains.价格弹性: 不适用。代价表现为结算摩擦和改道。量级判断是，单独断开 SWIFT 只是摩擦级；与央行储备冻结、代理行账户切断叠加为三件套，才达到瘫痪级（C2，俄案实证支撑）。2022 年对俄罗斯真正起主要作用的是约 3000 亿美元储备冻结（C3），不是报文断连。
chains.对谁而言: 应按事前准备分层，而不是按财富分层。俄罗斯在 2014 年克里米亚制裁威胁后就开始建设 SPFS、接入 CIPS，手中还有能源反筹码，因此 2022 年扛住了；伊朗的缓冲较薄，2012 年石油收入受重创。同一工具，对不同目标的杀伤并不相同。
chains.显式豁免: 俄罗斯第一大银行 Sberbank 最初因能源结算获豁免（2022-03），到同年 7 月才被纳入断连。发现八，即查制裁方自身依赖可以事前推断豁免，在这里第三次得到验证：欧洲冬季供暖离不开俄罗斯能源结算。还要再加一层，豁免是分批收窄的。欧洲想保留、美国想收紧的内部张力，靠逐步扩大名单化解；豁免不是开关，而是旋钮。
chains.header_en: SWIFT interbank messaging — Ukraine/Russia (2022 disconnection), Iran (disconnected twice, 2012 and 2018, direct material for the Iran case)
chains.停摆窗口_en: The fastest-executing switch in the whole table. Disconnection is a database operation, in place within hours of the EU regulation taking effect; in 2022 it was under two weeks from the start of the war (02-24) to the first Russian banks being cut off (03-02).
chains.下游_en: The money side of every chain in this table passes through here: the instruction end of letters of credit, correspondent-bank payments and commodity settlement.
chains.价格弹性_en: Not applicable. The cost takes the form of settlement friction and rerouting. Magnitude judgment (C2, supported by the Russian case): cutting SWIFT alone is friction-level; only stacked with a central-bank reserve freeze and severed correspondent accounts into a three-part package does it become paralysis-level. What really worked on Russia in 2022 was the freeze of about USD 300 billion of reserves (C3), not the messaging cut-off.
chains.对谁而言_en: Stratified by prior preparation, not by wealth. Russia started building SPFS, connecting to CIPS and holding energy counter-leverage after the 2014 Crimea sanctions threat, and withstood 2022; Iran had a thin buffer and its oil revenue was hit hard in 2012. The same tool, uneven damage.

chains.name: 美元清算
chains.header: 美元清算 — 乌克兰俄罗斯（2022 三件套与储备冻结）、伊朗（2012、2018 组合制裁），与 SWIFT（第 17 条）是同一场制裁的两条腿
chains.份额: 美元占已分配外汇储备约 59%（C3，IMF 口径，1999 年约 71%）；全球外汇交易约 88% 至少有一腿是美元（C3，国际清算银行 2022 年三年期调查口径）；跨行美元大额清算约 95% 经 CHIPS，即纽约的私营净额清算系统，日均约 1.8 万亿美元（C3，待运营方官方数核）；央行货币的最终结算由美联储 Fedwire 独家完成。替代方方面，人民币全球支付份额约 4%（C2–C3），而且 CIPS 相当一部分流量仍借 SWIFT 传报文。
chains.下游: 所有美元计价的跨境交易，包括原油等大宗商品结算、美元债务还本付息和贸易融资。本表每一条实物链的钱那一面，报文经 SWIFT（第 17 条），清算终局在这里完成。
chains.停摆窗口: 即时，而且没有“库存”这一说。被切断的实体，当天就无法完成这笔美元交易。缓冲全在被切断一方事先建立的替代路径上：俄罗斯 2014 年被威胁断开 SWIFT 后建设了八年，包括 SPFS、接入 CIPS 和能源反筹码，因此 2022 年扛住了金融瘫痪；伊朗没有预警期，2012 年石油收入受重创。
chains.重建时间: 技术上，建设替代清算系统按月计算，CIPS、mBridge 都已建成；真正的护城河需要数十年，甚至根本无法复制。替代美元，需要复制的不是一套系统，而是全世界愿意持有的一种货币，以及具有美债级深度的安全资产池。人民币有资本管制，欧元没有统一的共同债市场，目前没有第二个。
chains.价格弹性: 不适用。代价表现为换货币带来的汇率和流动性损耗。2022 年对俄罗斯真正最重的一击，是冻结俄罗斯央行约 3,000 亿美元储备（C3）；多数事后分析认为，这比 SWIFT 断连本身更重。
chains.对谁而言: 按事前准备分层，与 SWIFT 完全一致。有替代路径、有反筹码的目标会受到深度冲击，但可以缓冲；没有这些条件的目标，则接近金融窒息。
chains.显式豁免: OFAC 的通用许可和特定许可制度，就是这个节点的豁免通道。氮肥那条（第 4 条）获得的化肥交易通用许可，就是在这一框架下签发。豁免不是一次性例外，而是制度化的旋钮，与 SWIFT 那条 Sberbank 分批收窄的情形相同。
chains.header_en: Dollar clearing — Ukraine/Russia (the 2022 three-part package and reserve freeze), Iran (combined sanctions of 2012 and 2018); with SWIFT (no. 17) the two legs of the same sanctions
chains.停摆窗口_en: Immediate, and there is no such thing as "inventory": the cut-off entity's dollars cannot pass that same day. The whole buffer lies in the substitute legs the target built beforehand: Russia, threatened with SWIFT disconnection in 2014, built for eight years (SPFS, connection to CIPS, energy counter-leverage) and withstood financial paralysis in 2022; Iran had no warning period and its oil revenue was hit hard in 2012.
chains.下游_en: All dollar-denominated cross-border transactions: settlement of crude and other commodities, dollar debt service, trade finance. The money side of every physical chain in this table: messages go through SWIFT (no. 17), final clearing goes through here.
chains.重建时间_en: Technically, building a substitute clearing system is a matter of months (CIPS and mBridge are both built); the real moat takes decades or cannot be built at all, because replacing the dollar means copying not a system but a currency the whole world is willing to hold plus a pool of safe assets as deep as the Treasury market. The renminbi has capital controls, the euro has no unified common bond market; there is no second one at present.
chains.价格弹性_en: Not applicable. The cost takes the form of exchange-rate and liquidity losses from switching currency. The blow that really bit Russia in 2022 was the freeze of about USD 300 billion of central-bank reserves (C3); most later analyses weigh it above the SWIFT disconnection itself.
chains.对谁而言_en: Stratified by prior preparation, exactly as with SWIFT: targets with substitute legs and counter-leverage take a deep but bufferable shock; those without come close to financial suffocation.

chains.name: 海军与航道保障
chains.header: 海军与航道保障 — 霍尔木兹（2026 封锁与护航，正在进行，本表与该案例关系最直接的政治栈节点）
chains.份额: 保障侧接近单一供给者——在远离本土的海域持续护航，需要海上补给、区域基地和成建制防空三项配套，实际上只有美国具备这种能力；2026 财年可部署战斗舰队为 287 艘，低于上年的 296 艘（C3）。美国海军只剩四艘专用扫雷舰，前沿部署在日本；常驻中东的四艘复仇者级于 2026-01-09 装船运走，60 天后海峡被布雷，这里只记两件事的先后，不作因果判断。中断侧的门槛则在迅速降低：胡塞武装已用岸基导弹和无人机迫使红海航运改道，伊朗以水雷和岸基火力封锁霍尔木兹。
chains.下游: 按货量计算，全球八成以上贸易经海运完成（C3）；4 月 21 日，国际海事组织通报有 2,000 艘船和 20,000 名船员滞留湾内（C3）。
chains.停摆窗口: 即时——2 月 28 日革命卫队发布甚高频通告当天，通行量下降七成。
chains.重建时间: 扫雷能力需要按年重建，旧舰已经退役拆解，一支已经撤销的能力不能靠临时增加经费立刻恢复；基地和领空准入则可能在数天内改变，且不由资本决定，而由被请求国当天的政治判断决定。中断侧的重建壁垒接近于零：水雷可以重新布设，岸基导弹可以重新部署。
chains.价格弹性: 布伦特油价在 3 月 8 日四年来首次突破每桶 100 美元，峰值 126 美元；3 月是有记录以来单月涨幅最大的一个月（C3）。战争险费率从战前每航次约为船价的 0.125%，升至 7 月 20–26 日的 7.5–10%，为追踪期最高点；同一周过境船数从 82 艘降至 39 艘（C3，Lloyd's List Intelligence）。
chains.对谁而言: 按旗国区别对待——中断方在封锁后第 5 天即开始按旗国放行，中国籍船舶自 3-05 起获准通行，土耳其、印度、马来西亚、泰国和菲律宾籍船舶随后获准；第 66 天设立“波斯湾海峡管理局”发放通行资格。
chains.显式豁免: 按旗国放行是强制层的豁免形式。谁得到通行例外，本身就是可以观察的政治信号；放行清单与中断方的外交需要一致。
chains.header_en: Naval and sea-lane security — Hormuz (2026 blockade and escort, ongoing; the political-stack node in this table most directly tied to this case)
chains.停摆窗口_en: Immediate: on 28 February, the day of the Revolutionary Guard's VHF notice, transits fell by seventy percent.
chains.下游_en: By volume more than eighty percent of world trade moves by sea (C3); on 21 April the IMO reported 2,000 ships and 20,000 seafarers stranded inside the Gulf (C3).
chains.重建时间_en: Rebuilding mine-countermeasure capability takes years (the old ships have been decommissioned and scrapped; a capability that has been dismantled cannot be bought back at once with money); base and airspace access flips in days and is decided not by capital but by the requested state's political judgment that day. On the disrupting side the rebuild barrier is close to zero: mines can be re-laid, shore-based missiles redeployed.
chains.价格弹性_en: Brent broke USD 100 per barrel on 8 March for the first time in four years, peaking at 126; March was the largest single-month rise on record (C3). War-risk premiums went from about 0.125% of hull value per voyage before the war to 7.5–10% in the week of 20–26 July (the peak of the tracking period), and in the same week transits fell from 82 ships to 39 (C3, Lloyd's List Intelligence).
chains.对谁而言_en: By flag state: from day 5 after the blockade the disrupting side began releasing ships by flag (Chinese-flagged from 3-05, then Turkish, Indian, Malaysian, Thai and Philippine flags in turn), and on day 66 set up a "Persian Gulf Strait Authority" to issue transit permits.

chains.name: 战略储备
chains.header: 战略储备 — 霍尔木兹（2026-03 释放 4 亿桶是该案例的直接实证，与第 20 条海军与航道保障是“卡点—退路”配对）、乌克兰俄罗斯（2022 释放约 1.82 亿桶压俄油收入）
chains.份额: 这一栏与其他链的含义相反：其他链记录谁能切断供应，这条记录被切断的一方有多少缓冲。IEA 32 个成员国的应急储备合计超过 15 亿桶（C2–C3），约相当于全球 15 天消费；美国 SPR 是最大的单点储备，2026 年 6–7 月约为 316–326 百万桶（C3），法定容量 714 百万桶；中国另有一个不纳入 IEA 协调框架的独立储备池，规模不透明（C2）。
chains.下游: 所有石油进口经济体。供应中断时，炼厂依靠储备维持进料；储备释放也可被用作进攻工具，2022 年释放的目的之一就是压低油价、减少俄罗斯石油收入。
chains.价格弹性: 不适用，因为它不是商品；作用方向相反，是压低价格。2026-03 释放 4 亿桶，为史上最大规模，前次 2022 年约为 1.82 亿桶；触发条件是霍尔木兹流量降至冲突前不足 10%（C3）。
chains.对谁而言: 有储备的进口国把“立刻屈服”变成“可以支撑一段时间”；没有储备、也没有长期合同的经济体则直接暴露。亚太成员在 3 月立即释放，美欧从 3 月底开始释放，说明决策与物流之间存在地理时差（C3）。
chains.显式豁免: 不适用。但条约中有一项反向设计需要记录：IEP 将启动设为默认结果——触发门槛一旦达到，除非 29 国中至少 22 国投反对票，即达到特殊多数，否则各国必须在 15 天内实施（C4）。阻止这条退路比启动它更困难。
chains.header_en: Strategic reserves — Hormuz (the 2026-03 release of 400 million barrels is direct measured evidence for this case, paired with no. 20 naval and sea-lane security as "chokepoint and fallback"), Ukraine/Russia (the 2022 release of about 182 million barrels to depress Russian oil revenue)
chains.下游_en: All oil-importing economies. When supply is disrupted, refinery feed relies on it; releases are also used as an offensive tool, and one intent of the 2022 release was to push prices down and cut Russian oil revenue.
chains.价格弹性_en: Not applicable (not a commodity); the direction of effect is the reverse, pushing prices down. The 2026-03 release of 400 million barrels was the largest ever (the previous, in 2022, about 182 million), triggered by Hormuz flow falling below 10% of pre-conflict (C3).
chains.对谁而言_en: Importers with reserves trade "give in at once" for "hold out a while first"; economies with neither reserves nor long-term contracts are directly exposed. Asia-Pacific members released in March at once, the US and Europe from the end of March: there is a geographic lag between decision and logistics (C3).

chains.name: 制裁机器
chains.header: 制裁机器 — 乌克兰俄罗斯（2022 三件套的指定层）、伊朗（2012、2018 两轮，四十余年最长时段实验，伊朗案例的骨架材料）
chains.份额: OFAC 的射程覆盖全球美元体系和二级制裁。SDN 名单约有 19,065 行（C3–C4），OFAC 编制约 200–250 人（C2），但全球银行数十万合规员工共同放大其执行能力；欧盟制裁覆盖欧元体系，没有二级制裁，每项条例还须 27 国全体一致，匈牙利最常构成阻碍；联合国框架受否决权限制，对主要大国基本无效。
chains.下游: 所有持有美元代理账户的全球银行构成执行层；被指定实体的全部美元业务，包括合法贸易，都会同时受限。它限制的是主体的法律身份，不是某一类商品。
chains.停摆窗口: 指定当日生效——一份 CSV 多出一行，全球银行的合规筛查当天随之改变。
chains.重建时间: 被制裁方唯一真正的退路，是事先建设替代通道。俄罗斯自 2014 年受到威胁后建设八年，包括 SPFS、接入 CIPS 和减持美债，因此 2022 年避免了金融体系瘫痪；伊朗没有预警期，石油出口从 2011 年约 350 万桶/日降至 2013 年约 110 万桶/日（C3）。被冻结资产的解冻则需要数年，并取决于政治谈判。
chains.价格弹性: 不适用。量化影响的两个端点是：伊朗 2012–2015 年通胀超过 40%，货币贬值约 60%（C3）；俄罗斯 2022 年 GDP 实际增长 -2.1%，2023 年为 +3.6%（C4，IMF），明显好于当初 -6% 至 -15% 的预测，但汽车生产当年下降约 70%（C3），技术断代的成本仍在 5–10 年尺度上积累。
chains.对谁而言: 目标对象的特征决定制裁效果。高度依赖美元、没有替代通道、也没有反制筹码的对象，如 2012 年的伊朗，受损最深；拥有能源反制筹码且提前建设通道的对象，如俄罗斯，近期受损弱于预测；从未接入美元体系的对象，如朝鲜，几乎没有边际损失。
chains.显式豁免: OFAC 的通用许可和特定许可制度，是本表各链豁免的签发来源。氮肥一条（第 4 条）的化肥通用许可就出自该框架。豁免是制度中预设的调节方式，不是偶然例外。
chains.header_en: Sanctions machinery — Ukraine/Russia (the designation layer of the 2022 three-part package), Iran (two rounds, 2012 and 2018, the longest experiment at over forty years, the skeleton material of the Iran case)
chains.停摆窗口_en: Designation takes effect the same day: one more row in a CSV, and compliance screening at banks worldwide changes the same day.
chains.下游_en: Every bank worldwide holding a dollar correspondent account is the execution layer; all dollar business of a designated entity (including lawful trade) is restricted at once, because what it governs is the legal identity of the subject, not a class of goods.
chains.重建时间_en: The sanctioned side's only real fallback is building substitute legs beforehand: Russia, threatened in 2014, built for eight years (SPFS, connection to CIPS, reduced Treasury holdings) and withstood financial paralysis in 2022; Iran had no warning period, and its oil exports fell from about 3.5 million barrels/day in 2011 to about 1.1 million in 2013 (C3). Unfreezing frozen assets takes years and goes through political negotiation.
chains.价格弹性_en: Not applicable. Two endpoints for quantifying damage: Iran's inflation exceeded 40% and its currency lost about 60% in 2012–2015 (C3); Russia's real GDP was −2.1% in 2022 and +3.6% in 2023 (C4, IMF), far better than the initial forecasts of −6% to −15%, but car production fell about 70% that year (C3), and the cost of a technology generation gap keeps accumulating on a 5–10 year scale.
chains.对谁而言_en: The target's profile decides the effect function: highly dollar-dependent, with no substitute and no counter-leverage (the Iran-2012 type), the damage is deepest; with energy counter-leverage and corridors built beforehand (the Russia type), the near-term effect is weaker than predicted; never connected to the dollar system (North Korea), almost no marginal effect.

chains.name: 港口基础设施
chains.header: 港口基础设施 — 两案例的枢纽港节点内无专门数字（如实记：波斯湾侧与黑海侧均缺），欧盟外资审查空窗期与巴拿马收回特许是同型实测样本
chains.份额: 不同层的集中度差别很大。物理码头极度分散，仅欧盟 TEN-T 名下就有 283 个海港（C4），不存在集中度；码头运营特许存在中等集中度，MSC 经 TIL 加和记收购后约占 8.6%，成为全球最大运营商，PSA 约占 7.2%（C3，UNCTAD 2025）；岸桥接近单一供给，上海振华约占全球 70–80%、美国在用岸桥约占 80%（C3–C4）；港口操作系统疑似由少数供应商主导，份额未核。
chains.下游: 一国的海运进出口都必须经过某个码头；进出欧洲的货物中，74%、超过 3.4 亿吨经过欧盟港口（C4）。但单一港口中断时可以改用邻近港口，港口体系是网格，不是树状结构。
chains.停摆窗口: 单港中断的缓冲期是一次航次调整，约数天到数周；只有全港系统性中断，如罢工，见第 15 条，才会造成致命影响。
chains.重建时间: 新建码头需要数年，壁垒在资本和岸线许可，不在技术；收回已经授出的特许不是重建，而是处置——50 年长期合同下，主权强制收回需要新的法律授权。巴拿马 2026 年收回运河两端码头特许，引发约 20 亿美元国际仲裁，见第 15 条；岸桥替代需要数年至十年，属于产业政策规模的投入。
chains.价格弹性: 不适用；代价表现为运费和陆运接驳成本上升。
chains.对谁而言: 审查收紧时，首先承担代价的是持有特许的外资运营商，COSCO 最直接，不是货主。这与断供型节点先影响下游的情况相反。
chains.显式豁免: 有，而且属于第三种豁免形式，即按日期划分。欧盟新外资审查条例 2026/1386 的过渡条款 Art. 30(3) 明文规定，本条例不适用于 2028-01-17 前完成的外国投资（C4 原文）。COSCO 在塔拉戈纳取得的 50 年特许，2026-06 授予、未经任何外资安全审查（C4/C3），因而被条文本身排除，无法追溯处置。
chains.header_en: Port infrastructure — no dedicated figures in the node for either case's hub ports (recorded as is: Gulf side and Black Sea side both missing); the EU foreign-investment screening gap and Panama's reclaiming of concessions are measured samples of the same type
chains.停摆窗口_en: A single-port disruption is buffered by one voyage adjustment (days to weeks); only a system-wide port disruption (a strike, see no. 15) is fatal.
chains.下游_en: 100% of a country's seaborne trade passes some terminal; 74% of goods entering and leaving Europe (over 340 million tonnes) go through EU ports (C4). But a single-port disruption can be switched to a neighboring port; it is a mesh, not a tree.
chains.重建时间_en: A new terminal takes years (the barrier is capital and shoreline permits, not technology); reclaiming a granted concession is not "rebuilding" but "disposal": with 50-year contracts, sovereign forced reclamation needs new legal authority, and Panama's 2026 reclaiming of the terminal concessions at both ends of the canal brought about USD 2 billion in international arbitration (see no. 15); replacing ship-to-shore cranes takes years to a decade and is an industrial-policy-scale investment.
chains.价格弹性_en: Not applicable; the cost takes the form of higher freight and inland connection costs.
chains.对谁而言_en: When screening tightens, the first to pay are foreign operators holding concessions (COSCO most directly), not shippers; the reverse of cut-off-type nodes, which hit downstream first.

chains.name: 出口管制
chains.header: 出口管制 — 两案例共同的物项许可层（节点正文只写美中半导体一线，对俄 2022 出口管制与对伊管制在节点内无数据，如实记）；与制裁机器（第 22 条）是“许可层—指定层”配对
chains.份额: 这条链的“份额”是管辖覆盖率，不是产量。美国、荷兰、日本、英国和韩国合计约覆盖全球半导体设备制造的 90% 以上（C3，转引，节点注明待 SEMI 分国数据升级）；两家美国 EDA 公司占九成以上（C3）。合并清单共有 25,767 行，其中实体清单 3,420 行（C3–C4，本地 CSV 行计数）。其管辖范围依靠外国直接产品规则延伸：非美国工厂生产的先进芯片，只要含有受控美国技术，或使用受控设备生产，就受美国管辖（15 CFR 734.9(h)，C4 逐字在库）。
chains.下游: 全图中含美国技术成分的实物节点，都通过这一层与政治栈相连，包括光刻、代工、GPU、高带宽内存、EDA 和基站。对两案例而言，它是 2022 年对俄“断报文、断清算、冻储备”三件套之外的第四层，即物项许可；但节点中没有对俄规则的任何条文或数字。2022-02-24 对俄外国直接产品规则按记忆存在，未核，C2 以下，不进指标；对伊朗同样没有数据。
chains.停摆窗口: 许可状态可以即时改变——一封行政函当天生效。H20 一案于 2025-04-09 通知，次日起无限期生效，NVIDIA 当季计提 55 亿美元减值（C3，依 8-K）。实物缓冲需要另算：AI 芯片下游库存约为 2–6 个月（C2），EUV 设备没有备用库存，断供即停。
chains.重建时间: 目标方在 3 纳米以下没有自建路径，差距约为 5–10 年（C2）；7 纳米已可通过 DUV 多重曝光实现（C3），但代价是良率和成本，不能推广到更先进节点。控制方的重建壁垒不在技术，而在盟友关系是否稳定：荷兰、日本 2023 年已将美国规则的部分效力写入本国法律，分别为荷兰公报 2023/18212 和日本外汇法 23 类设备，均有 C4 原文在库。此后 ASML 受本国法约束，不再依靠美国规则触发。
chains.价格弹性: 不适用。代价表现为进口额和减值：中国集成电路进口额从 2021 年的 4,324 亿美元，降至 2022 年的 4,156 亿美元（−15.3%）和 2023 年的 3,492 亿美元（−16.0%），2024 年回升至 3,856 亿美元（+10.4%，C4，海关总署原表在库）。2024 年回升说明进口发生分层：管制针对先进型号，成熟制程进口恢复；封堵的实际结果再次是分流，而不是完全消失，与发现九相同。
chains.对谁而言: 许可阶梯分为七档：自由／筛查／须许可／逐案审查／推定拒绝／实体封锁／禁止美国人提供支持，见节点第 9 维。同一件物项对不同目的地和不同实体可能处于不同档位。承担代价的时间点也有两种：成文规则生效后，出口商如 NVIDIA、ASML 的营收先受影响；实体清单新增后，被列入的中国实体先受影响。
chains.显式豁免: 这条链的豁免形式与其他链不同，是被管制方自行制造的。三轮规格调整，即 2022-10 A800/H800、2023-10 H20、2025-04 行政函收口，在约 30 个月内完成，平均每 10 个月一轮（C3–C4）；做法是将参数压到阈值以下，形成自我豁免，直到规则追上。另有一档整体中止：实体清单 50% 所有权延伸规则（15 CFR 744.11(a)(1)）自 2025-11-12 起中止执行至 2026-11-09（C4，依 90 FR 50857，中止原因节点注明未核）。
chains.header_en: Export controls — the item-licensing layer shared by both cases (the node text covers only the US-China semiconductor line; no data in the node on the 2022 export controls on Russia or on Iran controls, recorded as is); paired with sanctions machinery (no. 22) as "licensing layer and designation layer"
chains.停摆窗口_en: A licensing-status flip is immediate: one administrative letter takes effect the same day (the H20 case: notified 2025-04-09, indefinite from the next day, NVIDIA booked a USD 5.5 billion impairment that quarter, C3 per 8-K); the physical buffer is separate: downstream inventory of AI chips about 2–6 months (C2), EUV tools have no spare inventory and stop the moment supply is cut.
chains.下游_en: Every physical node on the map containing US technology connects to the political stack through this layer: lithography, foundry, GPUs, high-bandwidth memory, EDA, base stations. Relation to the two cases: it is the fourth layer (item licensing) beyond the 2022 three-part package on Russia of "cut messaging, cut clearing, freeze reserves", but the node has no text or figures on the Russia rules (the 2022-02-24 foreign direct product rule for Russia exists from memory, unverified, below C2, not entered as an indicator); likewise no data on Iran.
chains.重建时间_en: The target has no self-built path below 3 nanometers, a gap on the order of 5–10 years (C2); 7 nanometers has been reached by DUV multi-patterning (C3), at a cost in yield and expense, and cannot be extended to more advanced nodes. On the controlling side the "rebuild barrier" lies not in technology but in ally adhesion: in 2023 the Netherlands and Japan wrote parts of the US rules into their own law (Dutch gazette 2023/18212, 23 equipment categories under Japan's foreign exchange law, both C4 on file), after which ASML is bound by its own national law and no longer triggered by US rules.
chains.价格弹性_en: Not applicable. The cost takes the form of import value and impairments: China's integrated-circuit imports were USD 432.4 billion in 2021, 415.6 billion in 2022 (−15.3%), 349.2 billion in 2023 (−16.0%), 385.6 billion in 2024 (+10.4%, C4, the customs administration's original table on file). The 2024 rebound is evidence of stratification: controls target advanced models, and mature-node imports recovered; once again the actual effect of blocking is diversion, not disappearance (same type as finding nine).
chains.对谁而言_en: Seven tiers by licensing ladder (free / screening / license required / case-by-case / presumption of denial / entity block / US persons barred from support, node dimension 9); the same item falls in different tiers for different destinations and entities; who pays first depends on timing: after a written rule takes effect, the exporters (NVIDIA's and ASML's revenue); after an Entity List addition, the listed Chinese entities.

chains.name: 造船
chains.header: 造船 — 船队与替代运力重建的上游（乌克兰俄罗斯：Arctic LNG 2 六艘破冰型运输船停摆是制裁传到造船层的实证；霍尔木兹：节点内无专门数据，它对该案例的意义是“运力损失后多久补得回来”这个慢变量）
chains.份额: 按修正总吨计算，2024 年新接订单中，中国约占 70%、韩国约占 17%、日本约占 13%，三国合计约 95%；按交付吨位计算，中国约占 54.6%（C3，Clarksons/BRS 二手引用，节点注明按船型的精确份额仍受付费墙限制）。美国海军情报局流出幻灯片称，中国造船产能约 2,325 万吨，美国不足 10 万吨，约为 232 倍；中国一个船厂的产能超过全美船厂总和（C3，海军发言人确认幻灯片真实，但提醒“非深度分析”）。船型分工上，中国主要生产散货船、油轮和中型集装箱船；韩国前三家船厂主要生产液化天然气船、超大油轮和超大集装箱船，韩国在手液化天然气船约 276 艘、约 710 亿美元、约占其订单吨位 52%（C3）。
chains.下游: 全球海运运力的更新和扩张，船舶寿命为 20–25 年，世界贸易按量计算八成以上经海运完成（C3）；各国海军，军舰不能交由敌对国建造，本国产能就是海军扩张上限；以及新液化天然气项目所需接货船。
chains.停摆窗口: 这是滞后型节点中最慢的一条，比磷钾肥慢一个量级。 船舶寿命为 20–25 年，短期断供不会使海运停摆，缓冲按年计算；真正的脆弱性在长期。一国若长期被排除在东亚产能之外，船队会逐渐老化、萎缩。面板的月度指标看不见这条链，年度指标也只能看到一部分，只能依靠订单簿、交付量和船队平均船龄等年度序列判断。
chains.重建时间: 单个大型干船坞需要数年；完整产能体系，包括熟练焊工、船用钢和配套供应链，以及足以摊薄固定成本的订单规模，需要十年以上（C2–C3）。美国和欧洲的商用远洋造船产能已接近归零，重建状态为 blocked/planned：有立法意图，如《美国船舶法案》等，但现场产能几乎为零。买家更换船厂时，标准船型可在三国之间调剂，交期为 1.5–3 年；高端船型在韩国的档期排至数年后（partial）。
chains.价格弹性: 新船价格随周期波动，不属于断供型。代价表现为政策加价：美国贸易代表办公室 301 港口费规定，中国建造、非中资运营的船舶每净吨收费 18 美元，或每标准箱收费 120 美元，取较高者，自 2025-10-14 起实施；到 2028 年逐年升至每箱 250 美元（C4，联邦公报附件原文在库）。一艘 20,000 箱集装箱船单次挂靠约需 240 万美元，节点按附件推算。另有对岸桥征收 100% 关税的拟议措施，见附件五，C4。
chains.对谁而言: 301 港口费首先由使用中国造船的全球船东承担，再传递给货主和进口国消费者；中国船厂利润薄，依靠国有托底承压，不依靠商业利润率，见节点 Q3/Q6；韩国船厂依靠高端船型溢价。
chains.显式豁免: 有两层。附件四给予液化天然气船三年豁免，2028 年起才逐步要求一定比例由美国造船承运（C4）；更大的一层是整套港口费自 2025-11-10 起暂停一年，至 2026-11-09（C4，依美国贸易代表办公室声明，中国交通运输部同步暂停对美报复性港口费）。“不合理”这一法律认定没有撤销，暂停的只是征收。同一套机制在不到一个月内经历了潜伏、激活和暂停征收。
chains.header_en: Shipbuilding — upstream of fleet and replacement-capacity rebuilding (Ukraine/Russia: the six ice-class carriers for Arctic LNG 2 stalled is measured evidence of sanctions reaching the shipbuilding layer; Hormuz: no dedicated data in the node; its meaning for this case is the slow variable "how long after a capacity loss can it be made up")
chains.停摆窗口_en: The slowest of the lagged chains, an order of magnitude slower than phosphate and potash. Ships live 20–25 years, so a short cut-off does not stop shipping; the buffer is measured in years; the real fragility is long-term: a country excluded from East Asian capacity for a long time will see its fleet slowly age and shrink. Monthly panel indicators cannot see this chain, and annual ones see only a corner; it can only be read through annual series such as order books, deliveries and average fleet age.
chains.下游_en: The renewal and expansion of world shipping capacity (ships live 20–25 years; over eighty percent of world trade by volume moves by sea, C3); national navies (warships cannot be outsourced to hostile countries, so domestic capacity is the ceiling on naval expansion); carriers for new LNG projects.
chains.重建时间_en: A single large dry dock takes years; a complete capacity ecosystem (skilled welders, marine steel and the supplier chain, order volume to spread fixed costs) takes decades (C2–C3); US and European commercial ocean-going shipbuilding capacity is near zero, and rebuilding is judged blocked/planned: legislative intent exists (the SHIPS for America Act and the like), on-site capacity is almost nil. Buyers switching yards: standard ship types can be shifted among the three countries with 1.5–3 year delivery, high-end types have Korean slots booked years out (partial).
chains.价格弹性_en: Newbuild prices move with the cycle; not a cut-off type. The cost takes the form of policy surcharges: the USTR Section 301 port fee on Chinese-built ships operated by non-Chinese carriers, USD 18 per net tonne or USD 120 per container, whichever is higher (from 2025-10-14), rising yearly to USD 250 per container in 2028 (C4, Federal Register annex on file); one call by a 20,000-TEU container ship about USD 2.4 million (node estimate from the annex). There is also a proposed 100% tariff on ship-to-shore cranes (annex five, C4).
chains.对谁而言_en: The 301 port fee falls first on shipowners worldwide using Chinese-built ships, then passes to shippers and importing-country consumers; Chinese yards run on thin margins and withstand pressure through state backing rather than commercial margins (node Q3/Q6); Korean yards rely on the premium of high-end types.

chains.name: 人民币跨境结算
chains.header: 人民币跨境结算 — 第 17／18 条“替代腿”判断的正面核对（乌克兰俄罗斯：2022 年后中俄本币结算的主通道；伊朗与中东能源结算：中伊、中沙人民币石油结算的清算腿）
chains.份额: 人民币占全球支付约 4–4.5%（C2–C3，SWIFT 月度追踪转引；美元同口径约 47–49%）。CIPS 2022 年处理 440 万笔、96.7 万亿元，直接参与行 77 家、间接 1,283 家（C4，人民银行《2023 年人民币国际化报告》原文在库）；2023 年约 123 万亿元、直参约 103、间参约 1,353、覆盖 115 个国家或地区（C3，官媒转引）；日均约 490 亿元，约为美元清算系统 CHIPS 日均 1.8 万亿美元的二十五分之一（C2 推算）。
chains.下游: 中俄贸易（2022 年起约七成以上以本币结算，C3；年贸易额约 2,400 亿美元，C3）；中伊贸易；部分中沙原油人民币结算（C3）；一带一路人民币贷款偿付。下游分布很散，且明显带有政治取向——最依赖它的，是被西方金融基础设施排斥的一方。
chains.重建时间: 建系统本身两年（已建）；扩张的瓶颈不在技术，而在人民币可兑换性与全球持有意愿，需数年到数十年。多边央行数字货币平台 mBridge 2024-06 达最小可行产品、2024-10 国际清算银行移交参与央行（C4），规模仍远小于 CIPS。
chains.价格弹性: 不适用。代价表现为清算摩擦、汇率损耗和可达性受限。
chains.对谁而言: 先付代价的是外资直接参与行——2023 年下半年，美国财政部经外交与监管渠道警告参与行：为受制裁俄罗斯实体清算人民币，将面临二级制裁并失去美元代理账户；部分外资行与有美元业务的中资中小行随后收紧涉俄业务（C3，媒体转引，节点标明无官方文件在库）。中国五大行几乎不构成独立操作方（与人民银行同属一个主权体系）。
chains.显式豁免: 方向正好相反——美国选择警告参与行，而不制裁 CIPS 本身。节点把这一选择视为其射程边界的暴露：它能让参与行自我审查，却不能直接关掉一个由主权方运营的系统。
chains.header_en: RMB cross-border settlement — the positive check of the "substitute leg" judgment in nos. 17/18 (Ukraine/Russia: the main channel for China-Russia local-currency settlement after 2022; Iran and Middle East energy settlement: the clearing leg of China-Iran and China-Saudi RMB oil settlement)
chains.下游_en: China-Russia trade (over about seventy percent settled in local currencies since 2022, C3; annual trade about USD 240 billion, C3); China-Iran trade; part of China-Saudi crude settled in RMB (C3); repayment of Belt and Road RMB loans. The downstream is highly dispersed and politically skewed: the heaviest users are those excluded from Western financial infrastructure.
chains.重建时间_en: Building the system itself took two years (done); the bottleneck to expansion is not technology but RMB convertibility and global willingness to hold it, years to decades. The multilateral central-bank digital currency platform mBridge reached minimum viable product in 2024-06 and was handed by the BIS to the participating central banks in 2024-10 (C4), still far smaller than CIPS.
chains.价格弹性_en: Not applicable. The cost takes the form of clearing friction, exchange-rate losses and limited reach.
chains.对谁而言_en: The first to pay are foreign direct participant banks: in the second half of 2023 the US Treasury warned participants through diplomatic and regulatory channels that clearing RMB for sanctioned Russian entities would bring secondary sanctions and loss of dollar correspondent accounts; some foreign banks and small and medium Chinese banks with dollar business tightened Russia-related business (C3, media reports; the node notes no official document on file). China's big five banks barely count as independent operators (they belong to the same sovereign system as the People's Bank).

chains.name: 能源制裁
chains.header: 能源制裁 — 乌克兰俄罗斯（对俄能源制裁的条文骨架：价格上限、指定、豁免与核查层）；霍尔木兹（2026-03 海峡关闭直接触发对俄制裁松动，是两案例互相传导的最直接实证）；伊朗（节点内只有 2012、2018、2019 三行历史表，无当前数据，如实记）
chains.份额: 这条链的“份额”是执行覆盖率，也就是规则实际管到多少贸易。俄罗斯原油运输（2026 年 1 月）：已列名影子油轮承运 68%、未列名影子油轮 8%、七国集团体系内船只 24%（C3，清洁空气研究中心月度追踪）；同期成品油正好相反，七国集团体系内船只承运 76%、影子船合计 24%（C3，同源）。在运 321 艘，其中影子船 114 艘，月末 81 艘挂假旗（C3）。有权签发能源制裁的主体很少：美国财政部海外资产控制办公室（单边、一天可动）、欧盟理事会（27 国一致）、英国制裁与反洗钱执行办公室，以及价格上限联盟中的日本、加拿大、澳大利亚。欧盟累计列名约 632 艘船（C2，多方报道，官方公报附件未核）。
chains.下游: 欧洲炼厂与成品油进口商（致命，合规判断出错就可能被扣货、失去银行服务）；印度炼厂（高——Rosneft 与 Lukoil 合计约占印度俄油进口 60%，C3，卡内基 2025-11）；船东与保赔保险俱乐部（致命，承保一船违规货，俱乐部整体就可能被指定）；各国银行合规部门；中国独立炼厂的敞口最小（结算多已离开美元通道）。
chains.停摆窗口: 这条链本来就不拦货，价格上限的要点是让油继续流，只压低卖方收到的钱（2026-01 俄化石燃料出口收入约每天 4.64 亿欧元、乌拉尔原油均价 54.2 美元每桶、对布伦特价差 9.85 美元，C3）。它的时间常数要从别处看，但目前只有两次观测，一次相隔一天，一次相隔约四个月，仍不能定出时间常数：2026-03-05 西德州中质原油单日涨 8.51%，03-06 美国财政部即给印度炼厂 30 天豁免，间隔一天；07-15 欧盟冻结自己的自动上限公式，距 03-05 已隔四个月。一天这次更像反证，而不是快速传导的证据——一份跨部门豁免文件很难在二十四小时内从起草走到签发；更简单的解释是，豁免在海峡关闭时已经开始准备，油价跳升和豁免签发有同一个更早的原因，即海峡关闭本身，而不是前者导致后者（2026-08-18 Sigma 反思层配对质疑指出）。翻转门槛则在两端：美国单边行政令加指定即可，欧盟连冻结一个自己写下的公式都要谈三天还没有结果（C3）。
chains.重建时间: 分两个方向。被制裁方的绕行是 operational——2022-12 上限生效，2023 年内影子船队形成规模，约 12 个月；关键在买家国家是否愿意接受非西方保险这一政治决定上（C3）。制裁方继续加码则 blocked——条文层的工具已经用尽（指定两大石油公司、列名六百多艘船、降上限），再往上只剩物理拦截；欧盟成员国只有零星动作（2026-06-01 法国在布列塔尼外海扣一艘，C2 待核），系统性拦截会碰上公海航行自由和谁来承担油价上涨这两件事。欧盟一轮制裁包立法需 2–4 个月（C2）；真正的壁垒是核查能力与联盟一致，后者没有前置期，会随油价变化。
chains.价格弹性: 不适用（不是商品）。代价表现为折价与分配：乌拉尔对布伦特折价 9.85 美元每桶，年损失百亿美元级（C2 推算）；印度 2026-03 豁免期内一次锁定约 6000 万桶，成交价比布伦特还高出 5–15 美元每桶——豁免期吃到价差的不是俄罗斯国库，而是握着在途货的中间商（C3）。
chains.对谁而言: 这条链里先付代价者的排序最反直觉——第一位是欧盟航运国的船东与保赔业务（希腊、马耳他、塞浦路斯），第二位是欧洲的成品油与天然气进口商，第三位是印度、土耳其炼厂，俄罗斯出口商排第四，且最慢。一项本来要打击对手的工具，前三位付款人都在制裁方自己一边（节点 D 维）。
chains.显式豁免: 本表中豁免形态最齐全的一条，而且全由制裁方自己签发。 结构性豁免：OFAC 通用许可 8K 号（经受制裁俄银行处理能源付款至 2025-04-30）、115 号（民用核能至 2025-06-30）、53 与 55 号（萨哈林二号项目与外交银行业务）、126 号（Rosneft/Lukoil 交易清退至 2025-11-21）（C3–C4，需补原文）；日本对萨哈林二号长期例外；欧盟制裁第四年的 2026-01，仍从俄进口约 11 亿欧元能源，其中液化天然气占 59%（C3）。危机豁免：2026-03-06 对印度 30 天（限 03-05 前已装船货，至 04-03）；历史同型为 2018-11-05 对伊朗八方 180 天豁免、2019-05-02 到期不续，伊朗出口从约 190 万桶每日降到约 40–60 万（C3）。自动公式的暂停也是一种豁免：第 18 轮制裁（EC/2025/1840）把上限降到 47.60 美元并加装公式——恒为前 22 周乌拉尔均价的 85%、每六个月复核；2026-01-15 首次自动运行降到 44.10 美元（C4，欧委会公告）；2026-07-15 同一公式因霍尔木兹危机推高油价，本应把上限抬到约 58 美元，欧盟当天冻结一周、拟推迟复核到 2027-01（C3）。
chains.header_en: Energy sanctions — Ukraine/Russia (the textual skeleton of energy sanctions on Russia: price cap, designations, exemptions and the verification layer); Hormuz (the 2026-03 strait closure directly triggered a loosening of sanctions on Russia, the most direct measured evidence of transmission between the two cases); Iran (the node holds only a three-row history table for 2012, 2018 and 2019, no current data, recorded as is)
chains.停摆窗口_en: This chain is designed not to stop cargo; the whole point of the price cap is to keep oil flowing and only squeeze what the seller receives (in 2026-01 Russian fossil-fuel export revenue was about 464 million euros a day, Urals averaged USD 54.2 per barrel, a discount of USD 9.85 to Brent, C3). Its time constant lies elsewhere, but there are only two observations so far, one a day apart and one about four months apart, not enough to fix a time constant: on 2026-03-05 WTI rose 8.51% in a day, and on 03-06 the US Treasury gave Indian refineries a 30-day exemption, one day apart; on 07-15 the EU froze its own automatic cap formula, four months after 03-05. The one-day interval itself reads more like counter-evidence than evidence of fast transmission: an interagency exemption document can hardly go from drafting to signature in twenty-four hours, and the simpler explanation is that the exemption was already being prepared when the strait closed, so the price jump and the signed exemption share the same earlier cause (the closure itself) rather than one causing the other (raised by Sigma's reflection-layer pairing challenge, 2026-08-18). Flip thresholds are at two extremes: the US needs only a unilateral executive order plus designation; the EU could not agree in three days of talks even to freeze a formula it wrote itself (C3).
chains.下游_en: European refineries and product importers (fatal: a wrong compliance judgment means cargo seized and banking services lost); Indian refineries (high: Rosneft and Lukoil together account for about 60% of India's Russian oil imports, C3, Carnegie 2025-11); shipowners and P&I clubs (fatal: insuring one non-compliant cargo exposes the whole club to designation); banks' compliance departments everywhere; Chinese independent refineries have the smallest exposure (settlement has mostly left the dollar channel).
chains.重建时间_en: Two directions. The sanctioned side's workaround is operational: the cap took effect 2022-12, the shadow fleet reached scale within 2023, about 12 months, hinging on the political decision of buyer countries to accept non-Western insurance (C3); the sanctioning side's escalation is blocked: the textual layer is exhausted (the two big oil companies designated, over six hundred ships listed, the cap lowered), and above that only physical interdiction remains, on which EU member states have taken only scattered action (2026-06-01 France detained one ship off Brittany, C2 awaiting checking); systematic interdiction runs into freedom of navigation on the high seas and the question of who bears the oil price rise. One EU sanctions package takes 2–4 months to legislate (C2); the real barrier is verification capacity and alliance unity, and the latter has no lead time and moves with the oil price.
chains.价格弹性_en: Not applicable (not a commodity). The cost takes the form of discount and distribution: Urals at a USD 9.85 per barrel discount to Brent, an annual loss on the order of ten billion dollars (C2 estimate); during the 2026-03 exemption window India locked in about 60 million barrels at once, at prices USD 5–15 per barrel above Brent; the one who pocketed the spread in the exemption window was not the Russian treasury but the middlemen holding cargo afloat (C3).
chains.对谁而言_en: This chain's order of who pays first is the most counter-intuitive in the table: first the shipowners and P&I business of EU shipping states (Greece, Malta, Cyprus), second Europe's product and gas importers, third Indian and Turkish refineries, and Russian exporters fourth and slowest. A tool meant to hit the adversary has its first three payers on its own side (node dimension D).

chains.name: 产油国协调
chains.header: 产油国协调 — 霍尔木兹（闲置产能约 80% 位于海峡之后，2026 年战争把生产端协调机器整个降为旁观者，是该案例“增供退路归谁管、此刻能不能动”的直接材料）；乌克兰俄罗斯（俄罗斯是八个自愿减产国之一，被制裁方坐在决定全球供给的机器里；2020 年沙俄价格战、2022-10 减产被消费端读作对价格上限的对冲）；伊朗（伊朗是欧佩克成员，节点内无伊朗配额或产量数据，如实记）
chains.份额: 这条链的“份额”分两层，含义不同。产量层面，欧佩克十二个正式成员和十个非欧佩克产油国于2016-12-10通过《合作宣言》联合，合称OPEC+，合计约占全球原油产量四成多（C3，节点标明精确数待补）。真正决定短期调节能力的是闲置产能：2025年四季度全球闲置产能逾4 mb/d，不含受制裁国（C3，国际能源署转述），主要在沙特。这是全球石油市场唯一的短期增量来源；页岩增产需要数月，新油田投产需要数年。名义上，22国共同决策；实际决策范围缩小了两次：先缩到八个自愿减产国，即沙特、俄罗斯、伊拉克、阿联酋、科威特、哈萨克斯坦、阿尔及利亚、阿曼。2023年起，两层自愿减产的1.65加2.2 mb/d全部由这八国承担，月度视频会议决定节奏（C3）。再往下，只剩沙特，因为只有它有能力通过增产压低油价，使配额表真正得到执行。两层自愿减产合计3.85 mb/d，约为全球供给的3.7%（C3加推算）：它影响价格，靠的是边际桶，不是总量。
chains.下游: 全球油价（价值流）以及所有石油进出口经济体；成员国财政，多数成员的预算平衡油价高于市场价，沙特约为90美元级，俄罗斯约为60–70美元级，均为C2二手转述，节点标待核；消费端的储备释放机器也按这台机器的闲置产能参数设定应急规模。
chains.重建时间: 闲置产能是纯成本，即井已经钻好却不采油。维持它需要按年投入，只有财政雄厚的大产油国负担得起。因此，惩罚能力自然集中在沙特手中，这由成本结构决定，不是制度设计的结果。协调机器本身没有复制品，也没有被复制的风险；它面对的是无法协调的产业形态，即美国页岩产业：数百家私人公司，以股东回报为导向，2014–16年把油价从100美元级压到30美元级，迫使各方在2016年扩大联盟。协调崩溃后，唯一的退路仍是重新协调：2020年3月沙特和俄罗斯谈崩，双方同时增产，一个月内油价从45美元级跌破20美元，WTI期货2020-04-20盘中收于−37.63美元（C4，公开市场数据）。一个月后，各方重新谈判，签下史上最大规模减产，约9.7 mb/d（C3）。
chains.价格弹性: 这条链无法阻止两个方向上的极端行情，只能调节常态区间。向下，2020-03协调崩溃一个月的量级见上；2025年油价全年跌18%，为2020年以来最大年跌幅，发生在协调机器每月开会的当年。向上，2026年布伦特峰值为126美元（C3，沿第20条口径）。
chains.对谁而言: 遵守配额的成员先付代价，因为他们把市场份额让给超产者和非成员；惩罚动作的先付代价者是所有成员的财政，包括惩罚发起者自己，因为增产压价会无差别减少所有产油国的收入。惩罚工具的强度，受到发起者自身承受能力的限制。2026年战争中，先付代价者换成了无法出口的海湾成员。非成员，即美国页岩股东，享受溢价却不承担配额义务，是结构性的搭便车者。
chains.显式豁免: 不适用，但有两条相反的情况需要记录。第一，成员可自由退出且不受惩罚：《合作宣言》不是条约，卡塔尔2019年、安哥拉2024年1月先后退出，均无后果（C3）；这与国际能源署的应急石油条约IEP不同，后者退出须走条约程序。第二，“补偿”把超产制度化地宽容下来：超产国的欠账按月列入秘书处补偿表，例如哈萨克斯坦2024年超产457 kb/d，须在2026年6月底前补齐（C3），但从未按表达标。这本账实际上把违约写成会计问题，避免直接承认配额已经失效。
chains.header_en: Producer coordination — Hormuz (about 80% of spare capacity sits behind the strait; the 2026 war reduced the whole production-side coordination machine to a bystander, direct material for this case's question "who controls the extra-supply fallback and can it move now"); Ukraine/Russia (Russia is one of the eight voluntary cutters; the sanctioned party sits inside the machine that decides world supply; the 2020 Saudi-Russian price war and the 2022-10 cut were read by the consumer side as a hedge against the price cap); Iran (Iran is an OPEC member; no Iranian quota or output data in the node, recorded as is)
chains.下游_en: The world oil price (value flow), and through it all oil-importing and exporting economies; member-state finances (most members' budget-balancing oil price is above the market price, Saudi Arabia around USD 90, Russia around USD 60–70, both C2 second-hand, marked in the node as awaiting checking); the consumer side's reserve-release machinery sets its emergency scale by this machine's spare-capacity parameters.
chains.重建时间_en: Spare capacity is pure cost (wells drilled and not produced); maintaining it is measured in years and only large producers with deep finances can afford it, so punitive capacity naturally converges on Saudi Arabia, a convergence born of cost structure, not institutional design. The coordination machine has no copy and no risk of being copied: its real opponent is the uncoordinable industrial form (US shale, hundreds of private companies driven by shareholder returns, which pushed the oil price from the 100s to the 30s in 2014–16 and forced the 2016 expansion of the alliance). After a coordination collapse the only way back is renewed coordination: in March 2020 Saudi-Russian talks broke down and both raised output, the oil price fell from the 45s to below 20 within a month, WTI futures closed at −37.63 intraday on 2020-04-20 (C4, public market data), and a month later everyone was back at the table signing the largest cut in history (about 9.7 mb/d, C3).
chains.价格弹性_en: This chain cannot contain extremes in either direction; what it regulates is the normal range. Downward: the one-month magnitude of the 2020-03 coordination collapse, above; the oil price fell 18% over 2025, the largest annual fall since 2020 (C3), in a year when the coordination machine met every month. Upward: the 2026 Brent peak of USD 126 (C3, on the same basis as no. 20).
chains.对谁而言_en: The first to pay for quota discipline are the compliant members (ceding market share to over-producers and non-members); the first to pay for a punitive move are all members' finances, including the initiator's own (raising output to cut prices hits every producer's revenue without distinction): the strength of the punishment tool is capped by the initiator's own tolerance. In the 2026 war the first payers changed places: the Gulf members unable to export. Non-members (US shale shareholders) share the premium without bearing quotas, structural free riders.

chains.name: 国内价格与出口禁令
chains.header: 国内价格与出口禁令 — 乌克兰俄罗斯（俄罗斯燃油出口禁令2023-09起滚动至2027-01-31，是制裁之外、由目标方自己国内政治触发的第二类中断来源）；霍尔木兹（2026年油价冲击放大了各进口国的价格义务——全球化石燃料补贴预计1.1万亿美元、日本单笔8000亿日元，是该案例向进口国财政传导的一条路径）；伊朗（节点无数据，如实记）
chains.份额: 这条链的“份额”是受管商品在世界市场上的出口集中度，因为大出口国的国内价格政治会直接改变世界市场供给。印度占全球大米出口约33%，2023年约1,700万吨（C3）；印尼占全球棕榈油出口约六成（C3通行口径，节点标精确值待补）；俄罗斯是全球最大的成品油出口国之一，禁令前柴油海运出口约100万桶每日量级（C2推算，节点标缺月度序列）。对本国出口接口，每个主权的控制力按定义都是百分之百。
chains.下游: 分国内和国外两侧。国内一侧是政权名义支持群体中的最大多数。主粮和燃油价格是少数能让这部分人直接感到压力的东西，因为它同时增加核心支持者的供养成本。国外一侧是进口国，它们承担价格义务外溢的后果：2023年印度禁令后，全球米价涨约15%，印度非巴斯马蒂白米出口同比降93%（C3，国际食物政策研究所等）。依赖印度大米的西非与孟加拉国进口商无从反制，因为切断出口的决定不由它们参与。
chains.停摆窗口: 即时型，而且是全表变化最快的接口之一。作出改变的都是行政分支，即俄政府令、印度商工部通知和印尼部长条例；不经立法，决定到生效只需数天。印尼2022年禁令04-28宣布、05-23解除，全程三周。但启动前可从上游观察：俄罗斯自2025年8月起，至少16座炼厂被乌克兰无人机打伤，38座中损失吞吐约90–100万桶每日（C3）；国内加油站出现断供。2025-09底，禁令延长并扩大到非生产商柴油；2026-07-30再次延长至2027-01-31，08-01生效，9月起豁免炼厂柴油、船燃和瓦斯油（C3）。物理供给受损和财政兑现能力减弱，是出口禁令的两个前导指标。
chains.价格弹性: 印度禁令后全球米价约涨15%，解禁后约跌11%（C3）。俄罗斯国内汽油零售价2026年内涨19%，7月末全国均价77.89卢布每升（C3，官方统计的转述）。这个读数已被价格管制压低。 要判断真实短缺程度，还须看排队和断供报道，节点标目前只有单一来源层。财政侧的量级为：俄罗斯燃油阻尼补贴2021至2024年分别支付6,745亿、2.171万亿、1.588万亿、1.815万亿卢布（C3，Interfax与TASS系列）；2025年实际支付比计划低1.4万亿卢布（C3，Interfax引财长）。法国价格盾2021–2024年毛成本约720亿欧元（C3，审计法院口径的二手转述）。联合国报告口径显示，2026年全球化石燃料消费补贴预计1.1万亿美元，并因战争带来的油价冲击扩大（C3，彭博转述2026-06-29）。
chains.对谁而言: 按工具区分，补贴由财政先付；禁令由本国生产者先付。俄罗斯炼厂同时承受三项压力：出口被禁、国内限价、无人机打掉产能；印度米商库存积压；印尼种植园收购价下跌。所有工具最后都把国内消费者设为受益方，这正是它们在政治上难以取消的原因。外国进口国从头到尾都是没有发言权的承受方。
chains.显式豁免: 有，设在禁令内部。政府间协定豁免下的转口方，如白俄罗斯等，拥有实际套利位置，豁免量占比仍是节点标缺口；2026-09起，炼厂柴油、船燃和瓦斯油也被豁免。方向与本表其他链相反：不是制裁方为目标方留下出口，而是目标方自己在禁令中为盟友和本国大企业留下出口。
chains.header_en: Domestic prices and export bans — Ukraine/Russia (Russia's fuel export ban, rolling from 2023-09 to 2027-01-31, is a second class of disruption source outside sanctions, triggered by the target's own domestic politics); Hormuz (the 2026 oil price shock enlarged the price obligations of importing states: global fossil-fuel subsidies projected at USD 1.1 trillion, a single Japanese package of 800 billion yen, one path by which this case transmits to importers' finances); Iran (no data in the node, recorded as is)
chains.停摆窗口_en: Immediate, and one of the fastest-flipping interfaces in the whole table: the flippers are all executive branches (a Russian government decree, an Indian commerce-ministry notification, an Indonesian ministerial regulation), no legislature involved, decision to effect in days (Indonesia's 2022 ban: announced 04-28, lifted 05-23, three weeks in all). But its onset can be observed upstream in advance: from August 2025 Ukrainian drones hit at least 16 of Russia's 38 refineries, taking out about 0.9–1.0 million barrels a day of throughput (C3), domestic filling stations ran dry, at the end of 2025-09 the ban was extended and widened to non-producer diesel, and on 2026-07-30 extended again to 2027-01-31 (effective 08-01, with refinery diesel, bunker fuel and gasoil exempted from September, C3). Damage to physical supply and shrinking fiscal capacity to honor obligations are the two leading indicators of a ban.
chains.下游_en: Two sides, domestic and foreign. The domestic side is the largest part of the regime's nominal support base: staple grain and fuel prices are among the few things that even a nominal constituency can make a regime feel, because they hit the cost of keeping core supporters at the same time; the foreign side is importing countries, which bear the externality of the price obligation: after India's 2023 ban world rice prices rose about 15% and India's non-basmati white rice exports fell 93% year on year (C3, IFPRI and others), and West African and Bangladeshi importers dependent on Indian rice had no recourse at all, because the decision to cut them off was made in a process they had no part in.
chains.价格弹性_en: After India's ban world rice prices about +15%, after lifting about −11% (C3); Russian retail gasoline +19% within 2026, a national average of 77.89 rubles per liter at the end of July (C3, relayed from official statistics; this is a reading suppressed by the price controls themselves, and the true degree of shortage must be read from queues and outage reports; the node marks it single-source). Fiscal magnitudes: Russia's fuel damper subsidy paid 674.5 billion, 2.171 trillion, 1.588 trillion and 1.815 trillion rubles in 2021 through 2024 (C3, Interfax and TASS series), with 2025 actual payments 1.4 trillion rubles below plan (C3, Interfax citing the finance minister); France's price shield cost about 72 billion euros gross in 2021–2024 (C3, second-hand from the Court of Audit); on the UN report's basis, global fossil-fuel consumption subsidies are projected at USD 1.1 trillion in 2026, expanded by the war's oil-price shock (C3, Bloomberg relayed 2026-06-29).
chains.对谁而言_en: By tool: with subsidy tools the treasury pays first; with ban tools domestic producers pay first (Russian refineries are hit from three sides at once: exports banned, domestic prices capped, drones hitting capacity; Indian rice traders sit on stock; Indonesian plantations see purchase prices fall); every tool's final beneficiary is set as the domestic consumer, which is exactly why it is politically hard to dismantle. Foreign importers bear it throughout with no say.

chains.name: 联盟机制
chains.header: 联盟机制 — 两案例共用的协调层（管制侧）：乌克兰俄罗斯（G7价格上限联盟2025年起分叉——欧盟与英国降至47.60美元、美国未跟，造出申报套利空间；欧盟制裁靠27国全体一致，第21轮被单国卡住）；霍尔木兹（节点对护航联盟的协调无内容，那部分在第20条另记二；如实记）；伊朗（节点对联合国安理会层面的协调无数据，如实记）；另有对手侧首次镜像框架（中国2025-10稀土域外规则，29天后暂停）
chains.份额: 当代技术管制联盟是单一枢纽结构，美国是唯一枢纽（结构事实，C2推算）。芯片三边协议于2023年由美国发起、在华盛顿谈判，文本从未公开（C3，广泛报道一致）；价格上限联盟由G7发起，但执行依靠美元清算和英美保险市场；AI扩散分层规则则是一份美国国内规则，单方面给全世界分层，第一层约18个盟国不设限（C3待核原文）。欧盟是第二个协调中心，采取27国全体一致规则，但它只协调自己的成员国。历史框架的规模为：CoCom在1949–1994年有西方17国，成员可否决；瓦森纳自1996年起有42个参加国，俄罗斯也在其中，全体一致且无约束力，均为C3。
chains.下游: 每一台单国管制机器的有效性。单国管制天然存在第三国转口和第三国替代供给的漏洞：2022-10美国单边管制后、2023年日荷规则落地前，中国半导体设备进口逆势增长（C3）。只有协调层能补上这类漏洞。能源制裁的核查也依赖成员国采用一致口径；联盟分叉会直接产生套利空间，两个价格上限并存时，货主会挑标准较低的一侧申报，套利量级仍是节点标缺口。
chains.停摆窗口: 这条链的“停摆”是联盟分叉或框架失效，速度在全表制度层中最快。AI扩散规则2025-01-15刊发、05-13撤销，距合规日仅两天，全程118天（C3–C4，联邦公报文号与两个日期C4可查）。框架可以一夜建立，也可以一夜撤销；被协调的物理节点，如光刻机、材料和保险市场，无法同样快速变化。这个时间差构成本节点全部动态的来源。反过来，重新接上很慢：三边协议要靠日本经产省2023-07-23生效的23项清单、荷兰2023-06-30公布、09-01生效的部级条例落实（C3）。美国规则生效日与成员国规则落地日之间约9–11个月的窗口，就是“无协调状态”的实测代价。
chains.重建时间: 要复制一个枢纽位置，需要在供应链多个环节形成技术渗透，这构成域外规则的物理前提；还需要储备货币与清算体系，构成制裁联盟的物理前提；并需要盟友网络的长期存量。中国2025-10-09出台的稀土域外规则，以0.1%为最低含量门槛，比照美国最低含量规则，是一次现场测试：文本可以很快模仿，29天后整包暂停，2025-11-07起暂停一年，至2026-11-10（C3）。域外规则的文本可以复制，但让第三国服从的执行结构，即银行、保险和航运在域外规则压力下的配合，无法快速复制。准备时间不在立法，而在生态。降级运行时，框架失去枢纽推动，已经对齐的成员国管制不会自动回退，例如日荷2023年清单已经成为本国法规；但它们会停在最后一次对齐的位置，不再跟进新的技术节点。
chains.价格弹性: 不适用。代价表现为成员国公司的对华营收，例如ASML在2023–2024年的对华营收占比约三成，东京电子约40%以上，均为C3待核年报；以及联盟分叉产生的套利空间。
chains.对谁而言: 先付代价的是成员国公司，如ASML、东京电子；其次是第三国，分层表中第二层国家先承担算力配额。枢纽本国公司则通过豁免结构后付代价：高带宽内存许可例外按“美国或特定盟国所有的公司”划线，把美光与SK海力士、三星区分开来（C3待核）。协调成本沉在成员国公司的资产负债表中，战略收益归枢纽。这个不对称会长期削弱联盟凝聚力，也是中国镜像框架试图利用的缺口。
chains.显式豁免: 豁免本身就是粘合剂。 当代联盟不靠条约，而靠“服从以换取豁免”。美国先制定域外规则，使盟国公司的产品即使在盟国境内制造，也可能落入美国管辖；再为“采用等效管制的国家”留出豁免口。2024-12-05规则中的设备域外条款和高带宽内存许可例外，都包含盟国豁免结构（C3待核原文）。盟国面对的选择不是是否配合，而是接受美国域外规则直接管辖，还是自己制定等效管制以换取豁免。联盟身份有三种状态：豁免成员、逐案谈判、管制对象。翻转权在枢纽一方。AI扩散规则单方把全世界放入三层，撤销时同样没有征求任何一方意见。
chains.header_en: Alliance mechanisms — the coordination layer (control side) shared by both cases: Ukraine/Russia (the G7 price-cap coalition forked from 2025: the EU and UK cut to USD 47.60, the US did not follow, creating room for declaration arbitrage; EU sanctions rest on unanimity of 27 states, and the 21st round was blocked by a single state); Hormuz (the node has nothing on coordination of the escort coalition; that part is in note 2 of no. 20; recorded as is); Iran (no data in the node on coordination at UN Security Council level, recorded as is); plus the first mirror framework on the opposing side (China's 2025-10 extraterritorial rare-earth rule, suspended 29 days later)
chains.停摆窗口_en: This chain's "outage" is alliance forking or framework repeal, and its speed is the fastest tier of the institutional layer in the whole table: the AI diffusion rule was published 2025-01-15 and rescinded 05-13, two days before the compliance date, 118 days in all (C3–C4; the Federal Register numbers and both dates are C4 checkable); a framework can be set up or repealed overnight, but the physical nodes it coordinates (lithography tools, materials, insurance markets) cannot move that fast, and that time gap is the source of all this node's dynamics. "Reconnecting" in the reverse direction is slow: the trilateral agreement landed through Japan METI's 23-item list effective 2023-07-23 and the Dutch ministerial regulation published 2023-06-30 and effective 09-01 (C3), and the roughly 9–11 month window between the US rule's effective date and the member states' landing dates is the measured cost of the "uncoordinated state".
chains.下游_en: The effectiveness of every single-country control machine: the natural loophole of single-country controls is third-country transshipment and third-country substitute supply (after the 2022-10 US unilateral controls and before Japan and the Netherlands landed theirs in 2023, China's semiconductor-equipment imports rose against the trend, C3), and only the coordination layer can close it; the verification layer of energy sanctions depends on member states using one standard, and an alliance fork directly creates arbitrage room (two price caps side by side, shippers declaring under the lower standard; the size of the arbitrage is marked as a gap in the node).
chains.重建时间_en: Copying a hub position requires technological penetration across many links of the supply chain (the physical precondition of extraterritorial rules) plus a reserve currency and clearing system (the physical precondition of a sanctions coalition) plus an existing ally network. China's 2025-10-09 extraterritorial rare-earth rule (a 0.1% de minimis threshold, modeled on the US de minimis rule) was a live test: the text was copied quickly, and the whole package was suspended 29 days later (from 2025-11-07 for a year to 2026-11-10, C3): the text of an extraterritorial rule can be copied, the enforcement structure that makes third countries comply (banks, insurers and shipping under the long arm) cannot; the lead time is not in legislation but in the ecosystem. Degraded operation: once a framework loses its hub's push, member-state controls already aligned do not automatically roll back (the 2023 Japanese and Dutch lists are national law), but they freeze at the last alignment and no longer follow new technology nodes.
chains.价格弹性_en: Not applicable. The cost takes the form of member-state companies' China revenue (ASML's China share around thirty percent in 2023–2024, Tokyo Electron over about 40%, both C3, annual reports awaiting checking) and the arbitrage room of an alliance fork.
chains.对谁而言_en: The first to pay are member-state companies (ASML, Tokyo Electron), then third countries (in the tiering table, second-tier countries pay first in compute quotas); the hub's own companies pay later through exemption structures (the high-bandwidth-memory license exception draws the line at "companies owned by the US or specified allies", treating Micron differently from SK Hynix and Samsung, C3 awaiting checking). The cost of coordination settles on member-state companies' balance sheets while the benefit (the strategic goal) goes to the hub; this asymmetry is a long-term corrosive of cohesion, and the crack China's mirror framework aims at.

chains.name: 港口准入
chains.header: 港口准入 — 两案例的岸端许可层（乌克兰俄罗斯：欧英美2022按旗关港、欧盟逐船列名近600艘、山东港口集团2025-01禁OFAC列名油轮、青岛评分制；霍尔木兹：节点的港口材料全在目的港一侧〔山东、美中〕，波斯湾装港侧仍无数据，第23条留下的港口层缺口只补上目的港那一半，如实记）；伊朗（节点对“受制裁原油”不按来源国拆分、正文未点名伊朗货，如实记）；另有美中港口费对射（2025-10-14生效、11-10同步暂停一年、2026-11-09到期）
chains.份额: 这条链的“份额”不在港口数量，而在特定货流绕不开的落地辖区。对受制裁原油，山东省原油日进口约 240 万桶，青岛一港约占中国原油进口六分之一（C3，路透社／彭博社口径）；受制裁原油占中国原油进口的比例，2024 年约为 27%，2019 年约为 15%（C3，转引追踪机构）。俄原油出口在 2026-01 有 68% 由已列名影子油轮承运（沿用第 27 条已核数），这些船可用泊位每少一档，俄油折价就会再深一些。对俄籍商船，传统挂靠港集中在欧洲，因此英国 2022-03-01、欧盟 2022-04-16、美国 2022-04 的按旗关港措施覆盖了其主要航线（C2–C3）；欧盟逐船列名至 2025-12-18 已累计近 600 艘，并改为按月滚动（C3，理事会新闻稿）。港口准入权天然按辖区分割，没有任何一方能拒绝全球港口，这也决定了它的漏洞形态。
chains.下游: 一切海运贸易，船公司的航线网络本就是一串进港许可；山东独立炼厂，即折价受制裁原油的买家；以及美中航线两端的进出口商。港口费会经运价附加费转嫁，先付者是两国进出口商，而非船公司（C3）。
chains.停摆窗口: 这条链没有货物库存，变化来自许可翻转。主权侧靠一纸法令翻转（欧盟须理事会一致，美中可由行政单方决定）；运营方侧则可能一纸内部通知、当天生效、没有程序。山东港口集团 2025-01 的禁令就是这样落地的（C3，交易商转述，无公开文书）。被拒方的降级状态因货种而异：油轮可作为浮仓撑数周到数月（2026 霍尔木兹危机滞留船即属此类），集装箱船几乎没有降级模式，冷藏货与船员补给只能按天计算。美中港口费呈现“上了发条的休眠”状态：2025-10-14 生效，11-10 同步暂停一年，法律框架未动；2026-11-09 到期后若不续，费率将按原计划升至第二档（C3）。
chains.重建时间: 许可方无需重建，每个沿海主权都天然持有这项权力；被拒方若要“自建一个不受该辖区管的落地点”，实际要新建接收设施、炼厂和买家生态，需以十年计。因此现实中没人重建，都是绕行：换港可即时到数周；海上过驳，如被列名船在塞得港外、马来西亚外海把货转给干净船，2025-08 被欧盟列名的两艘船过驳后，货物照样在宁波卸下（C3）；换旗、换名、换文书，则正被身份层反制，印度船级社自 2023 年以来已取消 200 余艘涉规避船的入级证书（C3）。港口费的应对则是换船不换航线，费用尚未生效，舰队已完成重组（C3）。
chains.价格弹性: 无价格序列。代价表现为抬价而非断流：过驳费、换船费、折价加深、航次拉长。2022 年后俄油折价中相当一部分，就是这些绕行成本的价格化。山东禁令公布当周，受制裁油轮的运费与折价立即变动（C3），市场把这道门的开合当作真实变量定价。费额量级（C2 自算，假设写明）：净吨 10 万的集装箱船，按中方首档每净吨 400 元计算，单航次为 4,000 万元人民币，按年五个航次上限约 2.8 亿元——足以让船公司把美国关联船调离中国航线，实际也已经发生。
chains.对谁而言: 禁令的先付者是被拒船的货主与船员；山东禁令的先付者是本省独立炼厂，表现为进料成本上升。收费的先付者是两国进出口商，美国农产品出口商的抗议是暂停谈判的推力之一（C2–C3）。第三国船厂（韩日）则是沉默受益方。
chains.显式豁免: 有两种，都是给在途货留一个出口：OFAC 对列名船设卸货通用许可（2025-01 批次至 02-27），欧盟对禁令前合同设过渡期（至 2022-08-10）；欧盟第 3ea 条另有农食、能源、人道例外清单（准确措辞节点标缺口，例外边界即执行边界）。粮食例外是欧盟设计中的减压阀，与第 4、5 条豁免判据同向。
chains.header_en: Port access — the shore-side licensing layer of both cases (Ukraine/Russia: the EU, UK and US closed ports by flag in 2022, the EU listed nearly 600 ships one by one, Shandong Port Group banned OFAC-listed tankers in 2025-01, Qingdao's scoring system; Hormuz: the node's port material is all on the destination-port side [Shandong, US-China], the Gulf loading-port side still has no data, so the port-layer gap left by no. 23 is filled only on the destination half, recorded as is); Iran (the node does not split "sanctioned crude" by origin and the text does not name Iranian cargo, recorded as is); plus the US-China port-fee exchange (in force 2025-10-14, both suspended for a year on 11-10, expiring 2026-11-09)
chains.停摆窗口_en: This chain has no cargo inventory; the flip is a flip of permission. On the sovereign side, one decree (the EU needs Council unanimity, the US and China act unilaterally by the executive); on the operator side, one internal notice, effective the same day with no procedure at all, which is how Shandong Port Group's 2025-01 ban landed (C3, as relayed by traders, no public document). The refused party's degraded state varies greatly by cargo: tankers can serve as floating storage for weeks to months (the ships stranded in the 2026 Hormuz crisis are in this state), container ships have almost no degraded mode, and reefer cargo and crew supplies are measured in days. The time profile of the US-China port fees is "wound-up dormancy": in force 2025-10-14, both suspended for a year on 11-10, the legal framework kept in place; if not renewed at expiry on 2026-11-09, the rate has already risen to the second tier on the original schedule (C3).
chains.下游_en: All seaborne trade (a carrier's route network is a string of port permissions); Shandong independent refineries (buyers of discounted sanctioned crude); importers and exporters at both ends of US-China routes (port fees are passed on through freight surcharges, so the first payers are the two countries' importers and exporters, not the carriers, C3).
chains.重建时间_en: The permitting side needs no rebuild (every coastal sovereign holds it by nature); for the refused side, "building a landing point outside that jurisdiction's control" means new receiving facilities plus a refinery plus a buyer ecosystem, measured in decades, so in practice nobody rebuilds and everyone reroutes: switching ports, immediate to weeks; ship-to-ship transfer at sea (listed ships transferring cargo to clean ships off Port Said or off Malaysia; two ships listed by the EU in 2025-08 transferred their cargo and it was still unloaded at Ningbo, C3); changing flag, name and papers (now countered at the identity layer: the Indian classification society has withdrawn class certificates from over 200 evasion-linked ships since 2023, C3); for port fees, changing ships not routes (the fleet was reshuffled before the fees even took effect, C3).
chains.价格弹性_en: No price series. The cost takes the form of higher prices, not stopped flow: transfer fees, ship-switching fees, deeper discounts, longer voyages; a large part of the post-2022 Russian crude discount is this rerouting cost priced in; in the week Shandong's ban was announced, freight rates and discounts for sanctioned tankers moved at once (C3), and the market prices the opening and closing of this gate as a real variable. Fee magnitude (C2, own calculation with stated assumptions): a container ship of 100,000 net tonnes under China's first tier of 400 yuan per net tonne pays 40 million yuan per call, about 280 million yuan a year at the five-call cap, enough to make carriers move US-linked ships off China routes, which is what happened.
chains.对谁而言_en: For ban-type measures the first payers are the refused ships' cargo owners and crews, and for Shandong's ban the province's own independent refineries (higher feedstock cost); for fee-type measures the first payers are the two countries' importers and exporters, and protests from US farm exporters were one of the pushes toward the suspension talks (C2–C3). Third-country yards (Korea, Japan) are silent beneficiaries.

chains.name: 稳定币
chains.header: 稳定币 — 乌克兰俄罗斯与伊朗共用的“绕开美元清算”候选通道（节点把俄罗斯、伊朗、委内瑞拉列为 USDT 制裁规避场景的用户，C3；但没有任何一国的通道量，如实记：本条原来被寄望为伊朗案例“唯一可能有当前数据的金融节点”，结果是结构有、数字无）；霍尔木兹（无关，如实记）
chains.份额: 市场高度集中在两家私人发行方：USDT（Tether）约 60–70%、USDC（Circle）约 15–20%，两家合计约 80–85%（C3，市场聚合数据）。USDT 流通市值在 2024 年初约为 1,000–1,150 亿美元，全部美元稳定币约为 1,400–1,600 亿美元（C3）；约 50–60% 的 USDT 在 Tron 链上流通（C2 推算），Tron 的低手续费，即每笔约 0.01 美元，是制裁规避场景选择它的实际原因。储备中约 80% 以上是美国国债与现金等价物（C3，Tether 季度证明书，BDO Italia 审阅、非正式审计），Tether FY2023 净利润约 62 亿美元（C3）。这是 fi 栈中唯一一个 access maker 为私人企业而非主权机构或国际组织的节点。
chains.下游: 加密交易所，USDT 是主要计价与结算资产，约占 Binance 现货交易量 60–70%（C2）；被 SWIFT 与美元清算边缘化的主体，俄罗斯、伊朗、委内瑞拉。Chainalysis 2023 年报告称，制裁相关实体接收约 148 亿美元加密资产——该数字包括所有加密货币，不只稳定币，且不分国别（C3）；以及新兴市场跨境汇款和 DeFi 协议。
chains.停摆窗口: 对被点名地址是小时级，冻结后余额即归零。Circle 在 OFAC 2022-08-08 指定 Tornado Cash 的当天，约一小时内冻结相关地址的 USDC，约 7.5 万美元（C4 官方博客加 C3 链上数据）；Tether 通常滞后数天（C3）。不需要法院命令，也不需要多国协调，发行方单边即可决定，因此这是全表制度层中翻转最快、颗粒度最细的开关，细至单个钱包。整个系统也有一次实测：2023-03-10 硅谷银行倒闭，Circle 约 33 亿美元储备存款在该行，USDC 一度跌至约 0.87 美元，约 24 小时恢复（C3+）。
chains.重建时间: 技术上，新建一个稳定币只需数周，合约加储备账户即可；规模化则以年计，取决于储备规模、交易所上架和监管资质。建一个不锚美元的稳定币，难点不在技术而在货币接受度，与第 26 条 CIPS 的扩张瓶颈同源。让现有稳定币免于 OFAC 管辖才是真正的高壁垒：把储备移出美国金融机构，就会同时失去美元信用基础，“美元锚”与“免美国管辖”不能同时成立。
chains.价格弹性: 不适用。代价表现为定向清零，即被冻结地址的等值资产归零；Tether 公开称累计协助冻结逾 5 亿美元 USDT（C3）；以及短暂脱锚，USDC 约 13%。
chains.对谁而言: 先付者是被冻结地址的所有者，其次是必须重构计价与结算的交易所，再次是将 USDT 作为美元储值的散户。发行方是“被要求冻结”后的先动者，不是先付者。制裁规避用户的替代选项最少，稳定币一旦受限，他们也最先失去渠道。
chains.显式豁免: 没有明文豁免，但有一层任何主权都够不到的例外，即底层公链。Tornado Cash 合约中的 ETH，约 4–5 亿美元量级（C2），没有机构能够冻结，合约代码照常运行（C4，技术事实）；控制在协议层失效时，会转移到“人”，如荷兰 2022-08 逮捕开发者 Pertsev、美国 2023-08 起诉 Storm（C3），以及法币出入口，如 Binance 2023-11-21 与司法部、FinCEN、OFAC 和解约 43 亿美元（C4）。另有一道司法边界：第五巡回法院 2024-11-26 Van Loon 案裁定，不可变智能合约不构成 IEEPA 下的“财产”，OFAC 无权将其列入 SDN（C4，判决书在库）——这是全表中第一个由法院为开关划出边界的实例。GENIUS Act（Pub.L.119-27，C4）已将发行方纳入联邦持牌、1:1 储备、联邦审计框架，控制从“发行方自愿合规”升级为法律强制。
