chains.name: 液化天然气
chains.header: 液化天然气 — 霍尔木兹（供给侧）与乌克兰（需求侧）
chains.份额: 2023 年全球贸易量 404 MT（C4，壳牌 LNG 展望 2024）；卡塔尔约 77–80 MT、约 19–20%，澳大利亚约 20%，美国 86 MT（C3–C4）。前三家合计约 57–60%。
chains.下游: 发电（全球发电量约 22–23% 靠天然气，日本约 33%）、工业供热、欧洲约 40% 家庭取暖、以及氮肥的原料。
chains.停摆窗口: 即时型，但有储气缓冲。欧洲储气库约 100 BCM，注入与提取有速率限制，不能像石油储备那样随时释放。
chains.重建时间: 新液化项目从投资决定到投产 5–7 年；新建陆上接收站 3–5 年；把现役船改成浮式再气化装置最快 12–18 个月；新造运输船交期 3–4 年（C2–C3）。
chains.价格弹性: 2022 年 8 月欧洲现货价峰值约 342 欧元每兆瓦时，是平时的十倍以上（C3）。
chains.对谁而言: 这一栏最关键。 欧洲 2022 年确实完成了替代，但条件是价格涨五到十倍、额外支出约一到二万亿欧元、需求压缩约 15%，加上那年冬天偏暖。同一个卡点，对富裕经济体是“很贵”，对付不起十倍溢价的中低收入经济体则接近于关闭。
chains.显式豁免: 俄罗斯的 Arctic LNG 2 被欧盟第十二轮制裁指定，而 Yamal LNG 刻意未被制裁（道达尔持股 20%）——这说明不制裁某一处，常常是因为制裁方自己也在其中。
chains.header_en: LNG — Hormuz (supply side) and Ukraine (demand side)
chains.停摆窗口_en: Immediate but with a gas-storage buffer. European storage holds about 100 BCM, injection and withdrawal are rate-limited, and it cannot be released at will the way oil stocks can.
chains.下游_en: Power generation (about 22–23% of world electricity comes from gas, Japan about 33%), industrial heat, about 40% of European household heating, and the feedstock for nitrogen fertilizer.
chains.重建时间_en: A new liquefaction project takes 5–7 years from investment decision to start-up; a new onshore receiving terminal 3–5 years; converting an existing ship into a floating regasification unit 12–18 months at the fastest; a newbuild carrier 3–4 years to delivery (C2–C3).
chains.价格弹性_en: In August 2022 the European spot price peaked at about 342 euros per MWh, more than ten times normal (C3).
chains.对谁而言_en: The most important column of this chain. Europe did complete substitution in 2022, but on condition of prices rising five to ten times, extra spending of about one to two trillion euros, demand compressed by about 15%, and a mild winter that year. The same chokepoint is "very expensive" for rich economies and "nearly closed" for lower- and middle-income economies that cannot pay a tenfold premium.

chains.name: 能源制裁
chains.header: 能源制裁 — 乌克兰俄罗斯（对俄能源制裁的条文骨架：价格上限、指定、豁免与核查层）；霍尔木兹（2026-03 海峡关闭直接触发对俄制裁松动，是两案例互相传导的最直接实证）；伊朗（节点内只有 2012、2018、2019 三行历史表，无当前数据，如实记）
chains.份额: 这条链的“份额”是执行覆盖率，也就是规则实际管到多少贸易。俄罗斯原油运输（2026 年 1 月）：已列名影子油轮承运 68%、未列名影子油轮 8%、七国集团体系内船只 24%（C3，清洁空气研究中心月度追踪）；同期成品油正好相反，七国集团体系内船只承运 76%、影子船合计 24%（C3，同源）。在运 321 艘，其中影子船 114 艘，月末 81 艘挂假旗（C3）。有权签发能源制裁的主体很少：美国财政部海外资产控制办公室（单边、一天可动）、欧盟理事会（27 国一致）、英国制裁与反洗钱执行办公室，以及价格上限联盟中的日本、加拿大、澳大利亚。欧盟累计列名约 632 艘船（C2，多方报道，官方公报附件未核）。
chains.下游: 欧洲炼厂与成品油进口商（致命，合规判断出错就可能被扣货、失去银行服务）；印度炼厂（高——Rosneft 与 Lukoil 合计约占印度俄油进口 60%，C3，卡内基 2025-11）；船东与保赔保险俱乐部（致命，承保一船违规货，俱乐部整体就可能被指定）；各国银行合规部门；中国独立炼厂的敞口最小（结算多已离开美元通道）。
chains.停摆窗口: 这条链本来就不拦货，价格上限的要点是让油继续流，只压低卖方收到的钱（2026-01 俄化石燃料出口收入约每天 4.64 亿欧元、乌拉尔原油均价 54.2 美元每桶、对布伦特价差 9.85 美元，C3）。它的时间常数要从别处看，但目前只有两次观测，一次相隔一天，一次相隔约四个月，仍不能定出时间常数：2026-03-05 西德州中质原油单日涨 8.51%，03-06 美国财政部即给印度炼厂 30 天豁免，间隔一天；07-15 欧盟冻结自己的自动上限公式，距 03-05 已隔四个月。一天这次更像反证，而不是快速传导的证据——一份跨部门豁免文件很难在二十四小时内从起草走到签发；更简单的解释是，豁免在海峡关闭时已经开始准备，油价跳升和豁免签发有同一个更早的原因，即海峡关闭本身，而不是前者导致后者（2026-08-18 Sigma 反思层配对质疑指出）。翻转门槛则在两端：美国单边行政令加指定即可，欧盟连冻结一个自己写下的公式都要谈三天还没有结果（C3）。
chains.重建时间: 分两个方向。被制裁方的绕行是 operational——2022-12 上限生效，2023 年内影子船队形成规模，约 12 个月；关键在买家国家是否愿意接受非西方保险这一政治决定上（C3）。制裁方继续加码则 blocked——条文层的工具已经用尽（指定两大石油公司、列名六百多艘船、降上限），再往上只剩物理拦截；欧盟成员国只有零星动作（2026-06-01 法国在布列塔尼外海扣一艘，C2 待核），系统性拦截会碰上公海航行自由和谁来承担油价上涨这两件事。欧盟一轮制裁包立法需 2–4 个月（C2）；真正的壁垒是核查能力与联盟一致，后者没有前置期，会随油价变化。
chains.价格弹性: 不适用（不是商品）。代价表现为折价与分配：乌拉尔对布伦特折价 9.85 美元每桶，年损失百亿美元级（C2 推算）；印度 2026-03 豁免期内一次锁定约 6000 万桶，成交价比布伦特还高出 5–15 美元每桶——豁免期吃到价差的不是俄罗斯国库，而是握着在途货的中间商（C3）。
chains.对谁而言: 这条链里先付代价者的排序最反直觉——第一位是欧盟航运国的船东与保赔业务（希腊、马耳他、塞浦路斯），第二位是欧洲的成品油与天然气进口商，第三位是印度、土耳其炼厂，俄罗斯出口商排第四，且最慢。一项本来要打击对手的工具，前三位付款人都在制裁方自己一边（节点 D 维）。
chains.显式豁免: 本表中豁免形态最齐全的一条，而且全由制裁方自己签发。 结构性豁免：OFAC 通用许可 8K 号（经受制裁俄银行处理能源付款至 2025-04-30）、115 号（民用核能至 2025-06-30）、53 与 55 号（萨哈林二号项目与外交银行业务）、126 号（Rosneft/Lukoil 交易清退至 2025-11-21）（C3–C4，需补原文）；日本对萨哈林二号长期例外；欧盟制裁第四年的 2026-01，仍从俄进口约 11 亿欧元能源，其中液化天然气占 59%（C3）。危机豁免：2026-03-06 对印度 30 天（限 03-05 前已装船货，至 04-03）；历史同型为 2018-11-05 对伊朗八方 180 天豁免、2019-05-02 到期不续，伊朗出口从约 190 万桶每日降到约 40–60 万（C3）。自动公式的暂停也是一种豁免：第 18 轮制裁（EC/2025/1840）把上限降到 47.60 美元并加装公式——恒为前 22 周乌拉尔均价的 85%、每六个月复核；2026-01-15 首次自动运行降到 44.10 美元（C4，欧委会公告）；2026-07-15 同一公式因霍尔木兹危机推高油价，本应把上限抬到约 58 美元，欧盟当天冻结一周、拟推迟复核到 2027-01（C3）。
chains.header_en: Energy sanctions — Ukraine/Russia (the textual skeleton of energy sanctions on Russia: price cap, designations, exemptions and the verification layer); Hormuz (the 2026-03 strait closure directly triggered a loosening of sanctions on Russia, the most direct measured evidence of transmission between the two cases); Iran (the node holds only a three-row history table for 2012, 2018 and 2019, no current data, recorded as is)
chains.停摆窗口_en: This chain is designed not to stop cargo; the whole point of the price cap is to keep oil flowing and only squeeze what the seller receives (in 2026-01 Russian fossil-fuel export revenue was about 464 million euros a day, Urals averaged USD 54.2 per barrel, a discount of USD 9.85 to Brent, C3). Its time constant lies elsewhere, but there are only two observations so far, one a day apart and one about four months apart, not enough to fix a time constant: on 2026-03-05 WTI rose 8.51% in a day, and on 03-06 the US Treasury gave Indian refineries a 30-day exemption, one day apart; on 07-15 the EU froze its own automatic cap formula, four months after 03-05. The one-day interval itself reads more like counter-evidence than evidence of fast transmission: an interagency exemption document can hardly go from drafting to signature in twenty-four hours, and the simpler explanation is that the exemption was already being prepared when the strait closed, so the price jump and the signed exemption share the same earlier cause (the closure itself) rather than one causing the other (raised by Sigma's reflection-layer pairing challenge, 2026-08-18). Flip thresholds are at two extremes: the US needs only a unilateral executive order plus designation; the EU could not agree in three days of talks even to freeze a formula it wrote itself (C3).
chains.下游_en: European refineries and product importers (fatal: a wrong compliance judgment means cargo seized and banking services lost); Indian refineries (high: Rosneft and Lukoil together account for about 60% of India's Russian oil imports, C3, Carnegie 2025-11); shipowners and P&I clubs (fatal: insuring one non-compliant cargo exposes the whole club to designation); banks' compliance departments everywhere; Chinese independent refineries have the smallest exposure (settlement has mostly left the dollar channel).
chains.重建时间_en: Two directions. The sanctioned side's workaround is operational: the cap took effect 2022-12, the shadow fleet reached scale within 2023, about 12 months, hinging on the political decision of buyer countries to accept non-Western insurance (C3); the sanctioning side's escalation is blocked: the textual layer is exhausted (the two big oil companies designated, over six hundred ships listed, the cap lowered), and above that only physical interdiction remains, on which EU member states have taken only scattered action (2026-06-01 France detained one ship off Brittany, C2 awaiting checking); systematic interdiction runs into freedom of navigation on the high seas and the question of who bears the oil price rise. One EU sanctions package takes 2–4 months to legislate (C2); the real barrier is verification capacity and alliance unity, and the latter has no lead time and moves with the oil price.
chains.价格弹性_en: Not applicable (not a commodity). The cost takes the form of discount and distribution: Urals at a USD 9.85 per barrel discount to Brent, an annual loss on the order of ten billion dollars (C2 estimate); during the 2026-03 exemption window India locked in about 60 million barrels at once, at prices USD 5–15 per barrel above Brent; the one who pocketed the spread in the exemption window was not the Russian treasury but the middlemen holding cargo afloat (C3).
chains.对谁而言_en: This chain's order of who pays first is the most counter-intuitive in the table: first the shipowners and P&I business of EU shipping states (Greece, Malta, Cyprus), second Europe's product and gas importers, third Indian and Turkish refineries, and Russian exporters fourth and slowest. A tool meant to hit the adversary has its first three payers on its own side (node dimension D).

primorsk.name: 普里莫尔斯克 / 乌斯季卢加

lines.name: 原油 · 黑海（俄与哈萨克）
天然气 · 乌克兰过境

site_points.name: kerch_bridge
site_points.ctx_where: 克里米亚与俄罗斯本土之间的刻赤海峡。
site_points.ctx_where_en: The Kerch Strait between Crimea and mainland Russia.
site_points.ctx_what: 连接克里米亚与俄罗斯的公路与铁路桥，克里米亚俄军补给的主要陆路。
site_points.ctx_what_en: The road and rail bridge linking Crimea to Russia, the main overland supply line for Russian forces in Crimea.
site_points.ctx_if_hit: 它断了，克里米亚的补给只能走陆桥（乌克兰南部被占区）或海运；它也扼住亚速海的出口，亚速海各港的粮食与钢材出口都从桥下过。
site_points.ctx_if_hit_en: If cut, Crimea can only be supplied over the land corridor through occupied southern Ukraine or by sea; it also commands the exit of the Sea of Azov, under which grain and steel exports from the Azov ports pass.

site_points.name: novorossiysk_port
site_points.ctx_where: 俄罗斯黑海东岸，克拉斯诺达尔边疆区。
site_points.ctx_where_en: Russia's eastern Black Sea coast, Krasnodar region.
site_points.ctx_what: 俄罗斯在黑海最大的港，原油、粮食、化肥的主要出口口，旁边是里海管道财团的码头。
site_points.ctx_what_en: Russia's largest Black Sea port, the main outlet for crude, grain and fertiliser, next to the Caspian Pipeline Consortium terminal.
site_points.ctx_if_hit: 它遇袭直接减少俄罗斯的原油与粮食出口，也是对俄制裁与价格上限所针对的货物；哈萨克斯坦的原油也从旁边出海。俄方油轮多关闭定位信号，港口平台计数是下限。
site_points.ctx_if_hit_en: A strike here directly cuts Russia's crude and grain exports, the very cargo the sanctions and price cap target; Kazakh crude also leaves from next door. Russian tankers often switch off transponders, so port-platform counts are a lower bound.

site_points.name: cpc_terminal
site_points.ctx_where: 俄罗斯黑海东岸，新罗西斯克以南的南奥泽列耶夫卡海上装油码头。
site_points.ctx_where_en: The eastern shore of the Black Sea, Russia, the offshore loading terminal at Yuzhnaya Ozereyevka south of Novorossiysk.
site_points.ctx_what: 里海管道财团的出口码头：哈萨克斯坦原油经一千五百公里管道到这里，从海上单点系泊装船。哈萨克斯坦大部分原油出口走这一条。
site_points.ctx_what_en: The Caspian Pipeline Consortium's export terminal: Kazakh crude arrives by a 1,500 km pipeline and is loaded at offshore single-point moorings. Most of Kazakhstan's crude exports go this way.
site_points.ctx_if_hit: 打这里断的是哈萨克斯坦的原油出口，而不只是俄罗斯的；它是被制裁方仍在运转的出口机器里最大的一处。影像上的局部变化没有火点异常相伴，本轮不作打击读。
site_points.ctx_if_hit_en: A strike here cuts Kazakhstan's crude exports, not only Russia's; it is the largest still-running export outlet on the sanctioned side. The local change in the imagery has no fire anomaly with it and is not read as a strike this round.

site_points.name: odesa_port
site_points.ctx_where: 乌克兰敖德萨，黑海西北岸。
site_points.ctx_where_en: Odesa, Ukraine, north-western Black Sea.
site_points.ctx_what: 乌克兰最大的海港，粮食出口的主通道。
site_points.ctx_what_en: Ukraine's largest seaport and the main channel for grain exports.
site_points.ctx_if_hit: 它关着，乌克兰谷物只能走多瑙河小港和陆路，运力只有海路的一小部分，埃及、土耳其、南亚的小麦买家最先受影响。港口平台在整个四百天窗口里对它的挂靠计数是零。
site_points.ctx_if_hit_en: While it is closed, Ukrainian grain can only leave through small Danube ports and overland, a fraction of sea capacity, hitting wheat buyers in Egypt, Turkey and South Asia first. The port platform records zero calls here across the whole 400-day window.

site_points.name: sevastopol_naval_base
site_points.ctx_where: 克里米亚塞瓦斯托波尔。
site_points.ctx_where_en: Sevastopol, Crimea.
site_points.ctx_what: 俄罗斯黑海舰队的司令部与主基地。
site_points.ctx_what_en: Headquarters and main base of Russia's Black Sea Fleet.
site_points.ctx_if_hit: 它被打影响俄罗斯在黑海的海上封锁与导弹发射能力，不在货物链上；黑海航道对乌克兰开不开，与这支舰队还在不在有关。
site_points.ctx_if_hit_en: A strike here affects Russia's capacity to blockade and launch missiles in the Black Sea, not any cargo chain; whether the Black Sea lane opens for Ukraine depends on whether this fleet is still there.

site_points.name: saky_air_base
site_points.ctx_where: 克里米亚西部新费奥多罗夫卡。
site_points.ctx_where_en: Novofedorivka, western Crimea.
site_points.ctx_what: 俄罗斯海军航空兵基地，对乌克兰南部出动的战机驻地之一。
site_points.ctx_what_en: A Russian naval-aviation base, one of the airfields for sorties over southern Ukraine.
site_points.ctx_if_hit: 不在供应链上；影响俄军在黑海西部的空中活动。
site_points.ctx_if_hit_en: Not on any supply chain; affects Russian air activity over the western Black Sea.

site_points.name: pivdennyi_port
site_points.ctx_where: 乌克兰敖德萨州，敖德萨以东。
site_points.ctx_where_en: Odesa region, Ukraine, east of Odesa.
site_points.ctx_what: 敖德萨三港之一，乌克兰的深水港，出口粮食、铁矿石和化肥。
site_points.ctx_what_en: One of the three Odesa ports, Ukraine's deep-water port exporting grain, iron ore and fertiliser.
site_points.ctx_if_hit: 同敖德萨，属乌克兰粮食出口主通道；它关着，谷物改走多瑙河。
site_points.ctx_if_hit_en: As with Odesa, part of the main grain-export channel; while closed, grain goes by the Danube.

site_points.name: chornomorsk_port
site_points.ctx_where: 乌克兰敖德萨州，敖德萨市西南约二十公里的海港。
site_points.ctx_where_en: Odesa region, Ukraine, a seaport about 20 km south-west of Odesa city.
site_points.ctx_what: 敖德萨三港之一，乌克兰粮食出口的主通道；也是乌克兰通向罗马尼亚、土耳其的滚装渡轮港。
site_points.ctx_what_en: One of the three Odesa ports, the main channel for Ukrainian grain exports; also Ukraine's ro-ro ferry port to Romania and Turkey.
site_points.ctx_if_hit: 黑海通道一断，乌克兰谷物只能改走多瑙河小港与陆路，运力只有海路的一小部分，对埃及、土耳其、南亚的小麦买家影响最直接。影像判为整幅变化，多半是季节或港池海况，不是设施变化；待人工看图。
site_points.ctx_if_hit_en: If the Black Sea route is cut, Ukrainian grain can only go through small Danube ports and overland, a fraction of the sea route's capacity, hitting wheat buyers in Egypt, Turkey and South Asia first. The imagery reads as whole-scene change, most likely season or sea state in the basin, not a facility change; awaiting a manual read.

site_points.name: tuapse_refinery
site_points.ctx_where: 俄罗斯黑海东岸，图阿普谢港，索契西北约一百公里。
site_points.ctx_where_en: The eastern shore of the Black Sea, Russia, at the port of Tuapse about 100 km north-west of Sochi.
site_points.ctx_what: 俄罗斯石油公司的黑海炼油厂，产品从旁边的码头直接出口，是俄罗斯成品油出口的黑海出口之一。
site_points.ctx_what_en: Rosneft's Black Sea refinery; its products are exported directly from the adjacent terminal, one of Russia's Black Sea outlets for refined products.
site_points.ctx_if_hit: 打这里减少的是俄罗斯的成品油出口，也是对俄制裁与价格上限所针对的那一部分货。影像上 3 月 15 日到 6 月 18 日之间厂区内约四公顷由浅色罐顶变成发黑地面，方位与 8 个火点异常日（最大 594 兆瓦）一致，疑似过火；序列上此后已回到基线，说明痕迹已清理或修复。十米分不出是罐体烧毁还是过火地面，要高分辨率影像或新闻核。
site_points.ctx_if_hit_en: A strike here reduces Russia's product exports, the very cargo the sanctions and price cap are aimed at. Between 15 March and 18 June about 4 ha inside the plant changed from light tank roofs to blackened ground, on the bearing of 8 fire-anomaly days (max 594 MW), a suspected burn; the series has since returned to baseline, so the trace has been cleared or repaired. At 10 m it cannot be told whether tanks burned or the ground was scorched; needs high-resolution imagery or news.

site_points.name: taman_port
site_points.ctx_where: 俄罗斯塔曼半岛，刻赤海峡东岸。
site_points.ctx_where_en: The Taman peninsula, Russia, east shore of the Kerch Strait.
site_points.ctx_what: 俄罗斯的散货码头，出口煤炭、粮食、化肥和硫。
site_points.ctx_what_en: A Russian bulk terminal exporting coal, grain, fertiliser and sulphur.
site_points.ctx_if_hit: 它遇袭减少俄罗斯的散货出口；7 个火点异常日，影像上没有对应的痕迹，火点可能在窗口外的谷物码头一侧。
site_points.ctx_if_hit_en: A strike here cuts Russian bulk exports; 7 fire-anomaly days leave no matching trace in the imagery, possibly on the grain-terminal side outside the window.

site_points.name: feodosia_oil_terminal
site_points.ctx_where: 克里米亚东南岸费奥多西亚。
site_points.ctx_where_en: Feodosia, south-eastern Crimea.
site_points.ctx_what: 克里米亚最大的油库，俄军在克里米亚的燃料储备点之一。
site_points.ctx_what_en: Crimea's largest oil depot, one of the fuel reserves for Russian forces in Crimea.
site_points.ctx_if_hit: 它被打影响俄军在克里米亚的燃料供应，不在货物链上。
site_points.ctx_if_hit_en: A strike here affects fuel supply for Russian forces in Crimea; not on any cargo chain.

site_points.name: belbek_air_base
site_points.ctx_where: 克里米亚塞瓦斯托波尔以北。
site_points.ctx_where_en: North of Sevastopol, Crimea.
site_points.ctx_what: 俄罗斯空军基地，战斗机驻地，也是塞瓦斯托波尔的机场。
site_points.ctx_what_en: A Russian air base with fighter units, also Sevastopol's airport.
site_points.ctx_if_hit: 不在供应链上；影响俄军在克里米亚的空防。
site_points.ctx_if_hit_en: Not on any supply chain; affects Russian air defence over Crimea.

site_points.name: dzhankoi_air_base
site_points.ctx_where: 克里米亚北部占科伊。
site_points.ctx_where_en: Dzhankoi, northern Crimea.
site_points.ctx_what: 俄军直升机与运输机的基地，也是克里米亚北部的铁路枢纽所在地。
site_points.ctx_what_en: A Russian base for helicopters and transport aircraft, at the railway junction of northern Crimea.
site_points.ctx_if_hit: 不在供应链上；它旁边的铁路枢纽是克里米亚与被占区之间补给的必经点。
site_points.ctx_if_hit_en: Not on any supply chain; the rail junction beside it is a choke point for supply between Crimea and the occupied territories.

site_points.name: engels2_air_base
site_points.ctx_where: 俄罗斯萨拉托夫州，伏尔加河东岸恩格斯市郊。
site_points.ctx_where_en: Saratov region, Russia, on the outskirts of Engels on the east bank of the Volga.
site_points.ctx_what: 俄罗斯远程航空兵的主基地之一，图-160 与图-95 战略轰炸机驻地，对乌克兰发射巡航导弹的出发地之一。
site_points.ctx_what_en: One of the main bases of Russia's Long-Range Aviation, home of Tu-160 and Tu-95 strategic bombers, a departure point for cruise-missile strikes on Ukraine.
site_points.ctx_if_hit: 打这里影响的是俄罗斯对乌克兰能源设施远程打击的出动能力，不在货物供应链上。影像判为整幅变化，多半是季节；本站不在火点框内（东界 41 度），火点无法核。
site_points.ctx_if_hit_en: A strike here would affect Russia's capacity to launch long-range strikes on Ukrainian energy infrastructure; it is not on any cargo chain. The imagery reads as whole-scene change, most likely seasonal; the site lies outside the fire-detection box (east edge 41°E), so fires cannot be checked.

site_points.name: mykolaiv_port
site_points.ctx_where: 乌克兰尼古拉耶夫，第聂伯河口。
site_points.ctx_where_en: Mykolaiv, Ukraine, at the mouth of the Dnipro.
site_points.ctx_what: 战前乌克兰的粮食与植物油出口港之一，2022 年起因河口被封基本停用。
site_points.ctx_what_en: One of Ukraine's grain and vegetable-oil export ports before the war, largely idle since 2022 because the estuary is blocked.
site_points.ctx_if_hit: 它能不能重开是乌克兰出口运力能不能恢复的一个标志；现状是关着。
site_points.ctx_if_hit_en: Whether it reopens is one marker of whether Ukraine's export capacity recovers; at present it is closed.

site_points.name: izmail_port
site_points.ctx_where: 乌克兰多瑙河下游伊兹梅尔，罗马尼亚对岸。
site_points.ctx_where_en: Izmail on the lower Danube, Ukraine, opposite Romania.
site_points.ctx_what: 乌克兰在多瑙河上的主要港口，黑海关闭后粮食出口的替代通道。
site_points.ctx_what_en: Ukraine's main Danube port, the substitute channel for grain exports while the Black Sea is closed.
site_points.ctx_if_hit: 敖德萨关闭后乌克兰谷物大部分从这里和雷尼装船，经多瑙河口出海；它遇袭就等于关掉替代通道。多瑙河口苏利纳外的等泊船 8 月中旬起从 10 条涨到 40 多条，等的就是进这里。
site_points.ctx_if_hit_en: With Odesa closed most Ukrainian grain loads here and at Reni and leaves through the Danube mouth; a strike here closes the substitute channel. Ships waiting off Sulina at the river mouth rose from 10 to over 40 from mid-August, waiting to come up here.

site_points.name: constanta_port
site_points.ctx_where: 罗马尼亚康斯坦察，黑海西岸。
site_points.ctx_where_en: Constanta, Romania, western Black Sea.
site_points.ctx_what: 黑海西岸最大的港，乌克兰谷物经多瑙河和铁路转运出海的最大替代口。
site_points.ctx_what_en: The largest port on the western Black Sea, the main substitute outlet for Ukrainian grain transhipped via the Danube and rail.
site_points.ctx_if_hit: 它是乌克兰粮食替代通道的另一端；它堵或遇袭，替代通道的运力就到顶。
site_points.ctx_if_hit_en: The other end of Ukraine's substitute grain route; if it jams or is struck, the substitute route has no more capacity.

site_points.name: primorsk_oil_terminal
site_points.ctx_where: 俄罗斯芬兰湾，圣彼得堡西北。
site_points.ctx_where_en: The Gulf of Finland, Russia, north-west of St Petersburg.
site_points.ctx_what: 俄罗斯波罗的海最大的原油出口港，波罗的海管道系统的终点。
site_points.ctx_what_en: Russia's largest Baltic crude export port, the end of the Baltic Pipeline System.
site_points.ctx_if_hit: 俄罗斯对欧洲以外出口的原油有相当一部分从这里装船，影子船队多从这里出发经丹麦海峡；它是对俄制裁与价格上限最直接的观察点之一。
site_points.ctx_if_hit_en: A large share of Russia's crude exports beyond Europe loads here, and much of the shadow fleet sails from here through the Danish straits; one of the most direct observation points for the sanctions and price cap.

site_points.name: ust_luga_port
site_points.ctx_where: 俄罗斯芬兰湾南岸，爱沙尼亚边境附近。
site_points.ctx_where_en: The southern shore of the Gulf of Finland, Russia, near the Estonian border.
site_points.ctx_what: 俄罗斯波罗的海的综合大港，出口原油、成品油、煤炭、化肥和液化气。
site_points.ctx_what_en: Russia's large multi-purpose Baltic port, exporting crude, products, coal, fertiliser and LPG.
site_points.ctx_if_hit: 同普里莫尔斯克，是俄罗斯绕开欧洲港口出口的主口之一；它和普里莫尔斯克每天出港的船数，是看俄罗斯出口有没有被制裁压住的直接读数。
site_points.ctx_if_hit_en: Like Primorsk, one of Russia's main outlets bypassing European ports; daily departures from the two together are the direct reading of whether sanctions are holding Russian exports down.

site_points.name: ryazan_refinery
site_points.ctx_where: 俄罗斯梁赞，莫斯科东南。
site_points.ctx_where_en: Ryazan, Russia, south-east of Moscow.
site_points.ctx_what: 俄罗斯石油公司的大型炼油厂，供莫斯科地区的成品油。
site_points.ctx_what_en: A large Rosneft refinery supplying the Moscow region.
site_points.ctx_if_hit: 它被打减少俄罗斯中部的燃料供应和成品油出口；乌克兰 2024 年起多次以无人机打击这类炼厂。不在火点框内，火点无法核。
site_points.ctx_if_hit_en: A strike here cuts fuel supply in central Russia and product exports; Ukraine has struck refineries of this kind with drones since 2024. Outside the fire-detection box, so fires cannot be checked.

site_points.name: moscow_refinery
site_points.ctx_where: 莫斯科东南郊卡波特尼亚。
site_points.ctx_where_en: Kapotnya, south-eastern Moscow.
site_points.ctx_what: 俄罗斯天然气工业石油公司的炼油厂，莫斯科市燃料的主要来源。
site_points.ctx_what_en: A Gazprom Neft refinery, the main fuel source for the city of Moscow.
site_points.ctx_if_hit: 它被打直接影响首都的燃料供应。不在火点框内。
site_points.ctx_if_hit_en: A strike here directly affects the capital's fuel supply. Outside the fire-detection box.

site_points.name: kstovo_refinery
site_points.ctx_where: 俄罗斯下诺夫哥罗德州克斯托沃，伏尔加河畔。
site_points.ctx_where_en: Kstovo, Nizhny Novgorod region, Russia, on the Volga.
site_points.ctx_what: 卢克石油公司的大型炼油厂，俄罗斯最大的炼厂之一。
site_points.ctx_what_en: A large Lukoil refinery, one of Russia's biggest.
site_points.ctx_if_hit: 它被打减少俄罗斯的成品油供应和出口。不在火点框内。
site_points.ctx_if_hit_en: A strike here cuts Russian product supply and exports. Outside the fire-detection box.

site_points.name: kremenchuk_refinery
site_points.ctx_where: 乌克兰波尔塔瓦州克列缅丘格，第聂伯河畔。
site_points.ctx_where_en: Kremenchuk, Poltava region, Ukraine, on the Dnipro.
site_points.ctx_what: 乌克兰唯一仍在运转的炼油厂，2022 年起多次遭俄军导弹打击。
site_points.ctx_what_en: Ukraine's only still-operating refinery, repeatedly hit by Russian missiles since 2022.
site_points.ctx_if_hit: 它被打，乌克兰的成品油要全部依赖进口；它是乌克兰一侧对应的能源设施。
site_points.ctx_if_hit_en: If knocked out, Ukraine depends entirely on imported fuel; it is the Ukrainian-side counterpart among energy facilities.

site_points.name: zaporizhzhia_npp
site_points.ctx_where: 乌克兰扎波罗热州埃涅尔戈达尔，第聂伯河卡霍夫卡水库畔，俄军占领。
site_points.ctx_where_en: Enerhodar, Zaporizhzhia region, Ukraine, on the Kakhovka reservoir, under Russian occupation.
site_points.ctx_what: 欧洲最大的核电站，六台机组，2022 年起停机并由俄军控制。
site_points.ctx_what_en: Europe's largest nuclear plant, six units, shut down and under Russian control since 2022.

supply_attacks.scope_note_en: The main table covers only facilities and people producing or transporting for Ukraine; incidents at general transport and power infrastructure, not stated to be linked to Ukraine aid, are listed separately and not counted in it. Attribution is graded in four tiers from official and prosecutors' wording. The table is maintained by hand and runs to the date of its latest row; monthly counts reflect the reports that could be found, recent months are easier to find, so the monthly bars should not be read directly as a trend.

reading.method_zh: 每条异常先对到最近的港口或锚地、算离岸距离，再按三条问：它在战前的常态里有没有解释；同一天同一处有没有别的船同样异常；船的身份（船旗、船名、有没有识别号）说明什么。判得出的写判断和依据，判不出的写为什么判不出。
reading.method_en: Each anomaly is first matched to the nearest port or anchorage and its distance from shore, then asked three things: is there an explanation in the pre-war pattern; are other ships anomalous at the same place on the same day; what does the ship's identity (flag, name, whether it has an ID) say. Where a judgement can be made it is written with its evidence; where not, the reason is stated.

black_sea.summary_zh: 黑海这一天的异常集中在一处：多瑙河口苏利纳外的等泊区七格船数陡增，合计六百三十八船时。敖德萨三港的挂靠数在整个四百天窗口里是零，乌克兰的粮食只能改走多瑙河，这七格就是那条替代通道排队的样子。没有信号中断、没有落在陆上的船位，这一天黑海没有定位干扰的迹象。
black_sea.summary_en: The Black Sea's anomalies that day sit in one place: seven vessel-surge cells in the waiting area off Sulina at the Danube mouth, 638 vessel-hours in all. Port calls at the three Odesa ports are zero across the whole 400-day window, so Ukrainian grain can only go by the Danube, and these seven cells are what the queue on that substitute route looks like. No AIS gaps and no positions on land: no sign of positioning interference in the Black Sea that day.
items_zh: 船数陡增 11 格，苏利纳外 7 格（北纬 44.9 到 45.1 度，东经 29.7 到 29.8 度）：最大一格 8 条船 140 船时，其余四格各 79 到 96 船时，合计 638 船时；这几格战前每天就有 2 到 24 船时，是多瑙河口本来的等泊区，这一天是战前的 6 到 46 倍。多瑙河从这里进去，上游是乌克兰的伊兹梅尔、雷尼和罗马尼亚的加拉茨。读法：敖德萨关着，乌克兰谷物走多瑙河小港出海，河口等泊的船越积越多。要跟的数是这七格每周的合计，它比新闻更早说明多瑙河通道是不是也堵了。

把苏利纳外这一片放回 7 月 15 日以来的逐日序列（停满 12 小时算等泊）：7 月中下旬每天 4 到 6 条，8 月 12 日 10 条，8 月 19 日 24 条，8 月 26 日 43 条，之后一直在 41 到 48 条之间，9 月 18 日 46 条，其中 24 条已经等了三十天以上。排队是 8 月中旬起在两周里涨起来的，之后稳住。瓦尔纳外同期一直是 18 到 31 条，没有同样的跳升，所以多瑙河口的跳升不是整个黑海西岸都堵，是多瑙河这一条通道的事。
瓦尔纳外 3 格（最大一格 6 条船 100 船时，战前日均 2.5 船时，四十倍）、布尔加斯外 1 格（6 条船 90 船时，十一倍）：保加利亚两个港的外锚地。没有单船身份，判不出等的是什么货；瓦尔纳是黑海西岸除康斯坦察外最近的替代装货港，这里排队与多瑙河口排队是同一件事的两侧，但这一句是推断。

异常停留 7 条里有身份的 5 条：俄罗斯旗杂货船「DONMASTER LEADER」在萨姆松以北 103 公里的黑海中部（北纬 41.8 度，东经 35.3 度）停满 24 小时，这一格战前每天不到 0.4 船时，离任何港口都远。一条俄旗船在黑海中央停一天，可能是等新罗西斯克的进港指令、也可能是避开某片海域，凭一天的数判不出，记下来，下周看它去了哪里。帕劳旗「ECE」在康斯坦察外 36 公里停 24 小时（这一格战前是零），帕劳旗近两年常见于老旧油轮与规避制裁的船，值得对它的船龄与船东查一次。马耳他旗「CHELSEA-3」在苏利纳外 9 公里、安提瓜旗「IN」在特拉布宗外 11 公里，都是港外等泊，正常。利比里亚旗集装箱船「MSC HARMONY III」停在马尔马拉海（北纬 40.9 度，东经 27.5 度）21 小时，是等博斯普鲁斯北上的船，正常。
两条无身份的停留：一条在博斯普鲁斯东北 78 公里的土耳其色雷斯海岸外（北纬 41.7 度，东经 28.6 度），一条在布尔加斯以南 100 公里、同一段海岸更北一点（北纬 41.9 度，东经 28.4 度），各停 24 小时，两格战前都近乎无船。两条无身份船同一天停在同一段海岸外，可能是等博斯普鲁斯的船溢到北面，也可能不是，没有船名核不下去。
没有信号中断、没有停在陆上、没有远离航迹：这一天黑海的定位没有受干扰的迹象。
items_en: Vessel surges, 11 cells, 7 of them off Sulina (44.9–45.1 N, 29.7–29.8 E): the largest cell 8 ships and 140 vessel-hours, four more at 79 to 96 each, 638 in all; these cells already held 2 to 24 vessel-hours a day before the war, being the Danube mouth's usual waiting area, and this day ran 6 to 46 times that. The Danube enters here, with Ukraine's Izmail and Reni and Romania's Galati upstream. Reading: with Odesa closed, Ukrainian grain leaves by the small Danube ports and the queue at the river mouth keeps growing. The number to follow is the weekly total of these seven cells; it will say before the news does whether the Danube route is also jamming.

Putting the Sulina area back into the daily series since 15 July ('waiting' = stopped 12 hours or more): 4 to 6 ships a day in the second half of July, 10 on 12 August, 24 on 19 August, 43 on 26 August, then 41 to 48 ever since, 46 on 18 September, of which 24 have waited over thirty days. The queue built up over two weeks from mid-August and has held since. Off Varna the count stayed at 18 to 31 over the same period with no such jump, so the jump at the Danube mouth is not the whole western shore jamming; it is this one route.

Three cells off Varna (largest 6 ships, 100 vessel-hours, forty times the pre-war 2.5 a day) and one off Burgas (6 ships, 90 vessel-hours, eleven times): the outer anchorages of Bulgaria's two ports. No individual identities, so what the ships wait for cannot be told; Varna is the nearest substitute loading port on the western shore after Constanta, and the queue here and the queue at the Danube mouth are two sides of the same thing, but that sentence is inference.

Of 7 unusual stops, 5 with identity: the Russian-flagged general cargo ship 'DONMASTER LEADER' stopped a full 24 hours in the central Black Sea 103 km north of Samsun (41.8 N, 35.3 E), a cell with under 0.4 stopped vessel-hours a day before the war and far from any port. A Russian ship stopping a day mid-sea may be waiting for a berth call at Novorossiysk or avoiding some area; one day's data cannot tell, so it is noted and checked next week for where it went. The Palau-flagged 'ECE' stopped 24 hours 36 km off Constanta (a cell with zero before the war); the Palau flag has been common on aged tankers and sanctions-evading ships in the last two years, worth one check of its age and owner. Malta-flagged 'CHELSEA-3' 9 km off Sulina and Antigua-flagged 'IN' 11 km off Trabzon are ordinary port waiting. The Liberian container ship 'MSC HARMONY III' stopped 21 hours in the Sea of Marmara (40.9 N, 27.5 E), waiting for a northbound Bosporus transit, ordinary.

Two stops without identity: one 78 km north-east of the Bosporus off the Turkish Thracian coast (41.7 N, 28.6 E), one 100 km south of Burgas a little further up the same coast (41.9 N, 28.4 E), 24 hours each, both cells nearly empty before the war. Two unidentified ships stopping off the same stretch on the same day may be Bosporus-bound ships spilling north, or not; without names it cannot be checked.
No AIS gaps, none on land, none far from tracks: no sign of positioning interference in the Black Sea that day.

baltic.summary_zh: 波罗的海这一天记下的异常大半是方法的问题，不是船的问题：基线取的是一二月，那时湾里结冰、游艇不出海，九月的游艇季一来，帆船和游船到处都是「战前没船去过的地方」，所以偏离航线 25 条、远离航迹 14 条、船数陡增 15 格几乎全是客船类（游艇）。真正与本项目有关的是俄罗斯波罗的海油港的出货和丹麦海峡的过境，这一天的数据里没有指向异常的信号。
baltic.summary_en: Most of the Baltic anomalies that day are a problem of method, not of ships: the baseline is January–February, when the gulfs freeze and yachts stay in, so once the September sailing season arrives, yachts are everywhere 'no ship went before the war'; hence 25 off-lane, 14 far-from-track and 15 surge cells almost entirely passenger craft. What matters for this project is loading at Russia's Baltic oil ports and transits of the Danish straits, and the day's data shows no signal there.
items_zh: 船数陡增 15 格，用当天逐船船型核过：最大的几格在大贝尔特（182 条船，177 条是客船）、基尔外（52 条，全是客船）、厄勒海峡（30 条，全是客船）、斯德哥尔摩群岛（24 条，全是客船，基线 0.03 船时，一万三千五百倍）、赫尔辛基外（25 条，全是客船）。整个波罗的海框 1 月 15 日有 2315 条船，9 月 18 日 5105 条，多出来的全是客船类。这不是异常，是基线季节错了。下周前该把波罗的海的基线改成 7 月 15 日到 8 月 31 日的夏季数据再算（记进航迹监测待办）。
停在陆上 2 条都不是干扰：塞浦路斯旗货船「NINA B」记在北纬 58.9 度、东经 12.8 度，那是瑞典的维纳恩湖，有运河通海、有湖港，货船本来就上去；另一条无名船在北纬 54.5 度、东经 9.7 度，是石勒苏益格的施莱湾，可通航的海湾。陆地轮廓没有把内陆水道挖掉，这两处要加进例外。

异常停留里的货船：巴拿马旗「KSS WILLIAM」在普里莫尔斯克外 37 公里停 24 小时，普里莫尔斯克是俄罗斯波罗的海最大的原油出口港，港外等泊本身是常态（那一格战前每天 0.5 船时）；马耳他旗「ADAM I」在芬兰湾中部停 24 小时；厄勒海峡与卡特加特一带四条（「NAVEN」「PEAK ANFIELD」「INDUSTRIAL DAWN」「RIX CRYSTAL」「ARAUCARIA」）是等过丹麦海峡的船。数据里的船型只分货船与客船，分不出油轮，所以看不出这些等过海峡的船里有没有俄罗斯的影子船队；要看那一条，得另加一个「普里莫尔斯克与乌斯季卢加每天出港的船数」的指标，不靠异常表。
偏离常走的路 25 条与远离一切已知航迹 14 条全是客船类，各只有 1 到 6 小时，是游艇；信号中断 2 条是芬兰与加拿大旗的帆船，各停过，不作信号读。
items_en: Vessel surges, 15 cells, checked against the day's per-vessel types: the largest are in the Great Belt (182 ships, 177 passenger craft), off Kiel (52, all passenger), the Øresund (30, all passenger), the Stockholm archipelago (24, all passenger, baseline 0.03 vessel-hours, 13,500 times) and off Helsinki (25, all passenger). The whole Baltic box held 2,315 ships on 15 January and 5,105 on 18 September, the increase entirely passenger craft. This is not an anomaly; the baseline season is wrong. Before next week the Baltic baseline should be rebuilt from 15 July to 31 August summer data (noted in the track-monitoring to-do).

Neither of the 2 positions on land is interference: the Cyprus-flagged cargo ship 'NINA B' at 58.9 N, 12.8 E is on Lake Vänern in Sweden, reached by canal and with lake ports, where cargo ships do go; the unnamed ship at 54.5 N, 9.7 E is in the Schlei inlet at Schleswig, a navigable inlet. The land outline does not cut out inland waterways; these two need adding as exceptions.

Cargo ships among the unusual stops: the Panama-flagged 'KSS WILLIAM' stopped 24 hours 37 km off Primorsk, Russia's largest Baltic crude export port, where waiting outside is itself normal (that cell had 0.5 vessel-hours a day before the war); the Malta-flagged 'ADAM I' 24 hours in the middle of the Gulf of Finland; four or five in the Øresund and Kattegat ('NAVEN', 'PEAK ANFIELD', 'INDUSTRIAL DAWN', 'RIX CRYSTAL', 'ARAUCARIA') are ships waiting to pass the Danish straits. The data's types distinguish only cargo from passenger, not tankers, so it cannot show whether Russia's shadow fleet is among those waiting; to see that line a separate indicator is needed, daily departures from Primorsk and Ust-Luga, not the anomaly table.
All 25 off-lane and 14 far-from-track items are passenger craft, each 1 to 6 hours: yachts. The 2 AIS gaps are Finnish- and Canadian-flagged sailing boats that stopped; not read as signals.

reading.conclusion_zh: 中东：没有指向新袭击的航迹信号。等着过霍尔木兹的船 7 月下旬到 8 月下旬翻倍、9 月稳在一百一十到一百三十条，一半以上等了一个月以上；上一版说科威特外海五十条船积压是误读，已改正；并靠不成立；一条无身份船在伊朗锡里岛与拉万岛两个原油码头之间关着信号往返，每周跟。黑海：多瑙河口的排队 8 月中旬起两周内从 10 条涨到 43 条，之后稳在 41 到 48 条，瓦尔纳没有同样的跳升；俄旗船 DONMASTER LEADER 黑海中央停一天，下周看去向。台海：东北与东海岸外三处同日船数陡增原因未定，避风与军事活动两个候选下周核；伊朗旗货船 ABYAN 海峡中部停一天，查航迹。波罗的海：异常大半是一二月基线碰上九月游艇季的假象，下周前换夏季基线；陆地轮廓要挖掉维纳恩湖与施莱湾。马六甲：无信号；亚齐西岸六条散货船成群抛锚，下周看散了没有。
reading.conclusion_en: Middle East: no track signal pointing to a new attack. Ships waiting to transit Hormuz doubled from late July to late August and hold at 110 to 130 in September, more than half waiting over a month; the earlier claim of fifty ships piling up off Kuwait was a misreading, now corrected; ship-to-ship transfer does not hold; one unidentified ship shuttles with its signal off between Iran's Sirri and Lavan crude terminals, followed weekly. Black Sea: the Danube-mouth queue rose from 10 to 43 ships within two weeks from mid-August and holds at 41 to 48, with no such jump off Varna; the Russian-flagged DONMASTER LEADER stopped a day mid-sea, to be followed next week. Taiwan: three same-day surges off the north-east and east coasts remain unexplained, weather and military activity to be checked next week; the Iranian-flagged ABYAN stopped a day mid-strait, track to be checked. Baltic: most anomalies are an artefact of a January–February baseline meeting the September sailing season; switch to a summer baseline before next week, and cut Lake Vänern and the Schlei out of the land outline. Malacca: no signal; six bulk carriers anchored in a group off western Aceh, check next week whether they dispersed.

theaters.plan: 地图收到福建沿海到台湾东岸；指标格：台海与吕宋海峡通过量、五个港口挂靠、共机架次近七日对全年、海事局三省军事类警告数、台积电与加权指数；时间对齐图：共机架次逐日（1 月起）、「Taiwan Strait」新闻量、台海通过量、高雄与基隆挂靠、海事局军事类警告按周计数；影响表按分级表的三级（月、周、日）列每级指标现值与阈值；定点影像的亮像素比序列另列一图。
theaters.plan_en: Map narrowed to the Fujian coast through Taiwan's east coast; indicator tiles: Taiwan Strait and Luzon Strait transits, port calls at five ports, PLA sorties last 7 days against the full year, MSA military warning counts for three provinces, TSMC and the TAIEX; aligned charts: PLA sorties day by day (from January), "Taiwan Strait" news volume, Taiwan Strait transits, Kaohsiung and Keelung port calls, MSA military warnings counted by week; the impact table lists the current value and threshold of each indicator at the three levels of the grading table (month, week, day); the bright-pixel-fraction series of site imagery in a separate chart.

why: 台湾海峡是东亚集装箱与能源航线的干道，吕宋海峡是台湾东岸与太平洋航线的出口。PortWatch（数据日 09-13）台湾海峡月均每日 212 到 259 艘，全年平稳，9 月 242；吕宋海峡 5 月起从六十多升到八九十。
海事局最近三十天的军事类航行警告，福建只有 2 条，广东 31 条、海南 10 条；台湾国防部通报最近三十天共机日均 5.3 架次，全年最高 2 月 13 日 42 架次。军事层没有偏离基线。
watch: 两条水道的每日通过艘数（封海时先降的是台湾海峡北段）；福建海事局的封海公告坐标与时长；共机架次对全年基线的偏离。
limits: 台海的过境船多数不靠台湾港口，通过量降了不等于台湾断供，要与高雄、基隆的挂靠一起看。

bypass.name: 台湾东岸绕行（吕宋海峡→太平洋）

why_en: The Taiwan Strait is the trunk route for East Asian container and energy shipping; the Luzon Strait is the outlet for Taiwan's east coast and Pacific routes. PortWatch (data day 09-13): the Taiwan Strait's monthly mean is 212 to 259 a day, steady all year, 242 in September; the Luzon Strait rose from the sixties to eighty or ninety from May.

MSA military navigation warnings in the last 30 days: only 2 for Fujian, 31 for Guangdong, 10 for Hainan; Taiwan MND bulletins put PLA aircraft at 5.3 sorties a day over the last 30 days, with the year's high of 42 sorties on 13 February. The military layer has not left its baseline.
watch_en: Daily transits through the two waterways (in a sea closure the northern Taiwan Strait falls first); coordinates and duration of Fujian MSA closure notices; PLA sorties against the full-year baseline.
limits_en: Most ships transiting the Taiwan Strait do not call at Taiwanese ports, so a fall in transits does not mean Taiwan is cut off; read it together with port calls at Kaohsiung and Keelung.

nodes.name: 高雄港、永安接收站与大林炼厂
why: 台湾最大的港：集装箱出口、原油进口（大林炼厂）与液化天然气进口（永安接收站）都在这里。PortWatch 高雄挂靠近七日日均 26.9，基线 28.2，比值 0.95。
它的上游在中东：原油来自海湾（拉斯坦努拉已停，走延布与富查伊拉的绕行）、液化天然气的一部分来自卡塔尔（拉斯拉凡收窄）。台海本身没有断点，但高雄的进口端已经在中东页的断点后面。
watch: 高雄挂靠数按船型（油轮、液化天然气船）；永安与大林的火点；美国自台湾进口集成电路的月报（海关，滞后两个月）。
limits: 台湾的液化天然气库存天数与各来源国份额，我们没有取到公开序列，枚举表里的数字待核。

upstream.name: 海湾（延布、富查伊拉绕行）

why_en: Taiwan's largest port: container exports, crude imports (Dalin refinery) and LNG imports (Yung-An terminal) all come through here. PortWatch 7-day mean port calls at Kaohsiung 26.9, baseline 28.2, ratio 0.95.

Its upstream is in the Middle East: crude from the Gulf (Ras Tanura stopped, rerouted via Yanbu and Fujairah), part of the LNG from Qatar (Ras Laffan narrowed). The Taiwan Strait itself has no break, but Kaohsiung's import side already sits behind the break on the Middle East page.
watch_en: Kaohsiung port calls by vessel type (tankers, LNG carriers); fire detections at Yung-An and Dalin; the monthly report of US IC imports from Taiwan (customs, two months' lag).
limits_en: We have not obtained public series for Taiwan's LNG stock days or the share of each source country; the figures in the enumeration table await checking.

nodes.name: 台中港与台中接收站
why: 台湾北部与中部电力的燃气来自台中接收站，它在海峡一侧，封海先影响的是它。PortWatch 台中挂靠近七日日均 16.6，基线 14.3，比值 1.16。
watch: 台中挂靠数；接收站的火点；台湾电力公司的备转容量（未接）。
limits: 同高雄，库存天数没有序列。

downstream.name: 台中电厂 / 北部电网

why_en: Gas for power in northern and central Taiwan comes through the Taichung terminal, which faces the strait, so a sea closure hits it first. PortWatch 7-day mean port calls at Taichung 16.6, baseline 14.3, ratio 1.16.
watch_en: Taichung port calls; fire detections at the terminal; Taipower's operating reserve (not yet connected).
limits_en: As at Kaohsiung, there is no series for stock days.

nodes.name: 新竹与台南科学园区（晶圆厂）
why: 先进制程晶圆厂集中在这两处。它们的进口端有两条在别的战区：氦气三成多来自卡塔尔（枚举表第 1 条，拉斯拉凡收窄），光刻胶与特种气体主要来自日本；出口端走桃园机场与高雄港。
今天的数：美国自台湾进口集成电路每月 14 到 16 亿美元，全年平稳（海关，最新 7 月）；台积电 ADR 与加权指数没有偏离。氦气的影响还没有在这两个序列上出现。
watch: 美国海关月报里自台湾进口集成电路；台积电与加权指数；氦气与光刻胶的公司公告（申报文件全文检索）。
limits: 晶圆厂的库存与长约我们看不见；氦气涨价传到晶圆厂出货的滞后没有实测。
why_en: Advanced-node fabs are concentrated in these two places. Two of their import lines lie in other theaters: over 30% of helium comes from Qatar (enumeration table no. 1, Ras Laffan narrowed), and photoresist and specialty gases mainly from Japan; exports go out through Taoyuan airport and Kaohsiung port.

Today's numbers: US IC imports from Taiwan run 1.4 to 1.6 billion USD a month, steady all year (customs, latest July); the TSMC ADR and the TAIEX show no deviation. The helium effect has not yet appeared in these two series.
watch_en: US customs monthly IC imports from Taiwan; the TSMC ADR and the TAIEX; company notices on helium and photoresist (full-text search of filings).
limits_en: We cannot see the fabs' inventories or long-term contracts; the lag from a helium price rise to fab shipments has not been measured.

nodes.name: 福建沿海（平潭、福州、厦门）
why: 分级表里月与周两级的指标都在这里：滚装渡轮离开定期航线南下、渔船留港、沿海机场与港口的车辆与飞机计数、海事局封海公告。今天的数：福建海事局三十天军事类警告 2 条；福州挂靠近七日 8.1（基线 7.3），厦门 20.7（基线 20.1），都在基线上。
定点影像十一处从 9 月 13 日起每五天一景攒基线，福建三处整月云量过高，只有雷达影像（Copernicus 账号已建）看得穿。
watch: aisstream 的岸站流里渤海轮渡等滚装船的位置（台海周边覆盖好，四十五秒 72 条船）；Global Fishing Watch 的渔船船队；六处机场与港口的影像计数；海事局福建分局公告。
limits: 影像十米分辨率数不了战斗机；集结与演习在民用数据上留下的痕迹几乎一样。
why_en: The month-level and week-level indicators of the grading table are all here: ro-ro ferries leaving their scheduled routes to head south, fishing boats staying in port, vehicle and aircraft counts at coastal airfields and ports, MSA sea-closure notices. Today's numbers: 2 Fujian MSA military warnings in 30 days; 7-day port calls at Fuzhou 8.1 (baseline 7.3), Xiamen 20.7 (baseline 20.1), both on baseline.

Site imagery at 11 sites has been accumulating a baseline at one scene every five days since 13 September; the three Fujian sites had too much cloud all month, and only radar imagery (Copernicus account already set up) can see through it.
watch_en: Positions of ro-ro ships such as the Bohai ferries in the aisstream shore-station feed (good coverage around the Taiwan Strait, 72 ships in 45 seconds); fishing fleets from Global Fishing Watch; imagery counts at six airfields and ports; Fujian MSA notices.
limits_en: Ten-metre imagery cannot count fighter aircraft; a build-up and an exercise leave almost the same traces in civilian data.

nodes.name: 中东来源（卡塔尔液化天然气与氦、海湾原油）
why: 台湾的能源与晶圆厂原料有三条线的上游在中东页的断点后面：卡塔尔液化天然气（拉斯拉凡挂靠只剩战前的四分之一到三分之一）、卡塔尔氦气（同一码头）、海湾原油（霍尔木兹已停，绕行的延布 8 月起也停了）。这一站不在台海，但台海页少了它就读不出台湾今天的处境。
watch: 中东页的拉斯拉凡、延布、富查伊拉三站；高雄与台中的液化天然气船挂靠。
limits: 台湾各来源国的份额没有取到公开序列。

bypass.name: 澳大利亚 / 美国液化天然气替代

why_en: Three lines of Taiwan's energy and fab inputs have their upstream behind the break on the Middle East page: Qatari LNG (Ras Laffan port calls down to a quarter to a third of pre-war), Qatari helium (same terminal), Gulf crude (Hormuz stopped, and the Yanbu bypass stopped too from August). This station is not in the Taiwan Strait, but without it the Taiwan page cannot show Taiwan's position today.
watch_en: The Ras Laffan, Yanbu and Fujairah stations on the Middle East page; LNG-carrier calls at Kaohsiung and Taichung.
limits_en: No public series has been obtained for the share of each of Taiwan's source countries.

site_points.name: yungan_lng
site_points.ctx_where: 台湾高雄永安。
site_points.ctx_where_en: Yong'an, Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
site_points.ctx_what: 台湾第一座液化天然气接收站，供南部电厂。
site_points.ctx_what_en: Taiwan's first LNG receiving terminal, supplying the southern power plants.
site_points.ctx_if_hit: 台湾发电四成以上靠天然气，液化天然气的库存只有一两周；接收站停用，南部的电就要限。它给栈里「液化天然气」节点供影像信号。
site_points.ctx_if_hit_en: Over forty percent of Taiwan's electricity comes from gas, with only one or two weeks of LNG stock; if the terminal stops, the south must ration power. It supplies the imagery signal for the 'LNG' node.

site_points.name: taichung_lng
site_points.ctx_where: 台湾台中港区。
site_points.ctx_where_en: Taichung port area, Taiwan.
site_points.ctx_what: 台湾第二座液化天然气接收站，供中部电厂。
site_points.ctx_what_en: Taiwan's second LNG receiving terminal, supplying the central power plants.
site_points.ctx_if_hit: 同永安；两站合起来是台湾天然气进口的全部入口，台中港的挂靠数是它的直接读数。
site_points.ctx_if_hit_en: As with Yong'an; the two together are the entire entry point for Taiwan's gas imports, and Taichung port calls are its direct reading.

site_points.name: kaohsiung_dalin_refinery
site_points.ctx_where: 台湾高雄大林蒲，高雄港南侧。
site_points.ctx_where_en: Dalinpu, Kaohsiung, Taiwan, south of Kaohsiung port.
site_points.ctx_what: 台湾中油最大的炼油厂，供台湾大部分成品油。
site_points.ctx_what_en: CPC's largest refinery, supplying most of Taiwan's refined products.
site_points.ctx_if_hit: 它停，台湾的汽柴油和航空燃料供应就要靠进口成品油；它给栈里「炼化产能」节点供影像信号。
site_points.ctx_if_hit_en: If it stops, Taiwan's petrol, diesel and jet fuel depend on imported products; it supplies the imagery signal for the 'refining capacity' node.

site_points.name: mailiao_refinery
site_points.ctx_where: 台湾云林麦寮，西海岸填海工业区。
site_points.ctx_where_en: Mailiao, Yunlin, Taiwan, a reclaimed industrial zone on the west coast.
site_points.ctx_what: 台塑六轻工业区：台湾最大的石化基地，含炼油厂与乙烯裂解装置，供台湾大部分石化原料。
site_points.ctx_what_en: Formosa Plastics' Sixth Naphtha Cracker complex: Taiwan's largest petrochemical site, with a refinery and ethylene crackers supplying most of Taiwan's petrochemical feedstock.
site_points.ctx_if_hit: 打这里影响台湾的成品油和塑料原料供应，也断了晶圆厂上游的一部分化学品来源。影像判为整幅变化，后景 9 月 21 日之后还没有可用景；待人工看图。
site_points.ctx_if_hit_en: A strike here would hit Taiwan's fuel and plastics feedstock supply and cut part of the chemicals feeding the wafer fabs. The imagery reads as whole-scene change; no usable scene yet after the 21 September after-scene; awaiting a manual read.

site_points.name: zuoying_naval_base
site_points.ctx_where: 台湾高雄左营。
site_points.ctx_where_en: Zuoying, Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
site_points.ctx_what: 台湾海军的主基地和舰队司令部所在地。
site_points.ctx_what_en: Taiwan's main naval base and fleet headquarters.
site_points.ctx_if_hit: 打这里影响的是台湾海军的出动，不在货物供应链上；它挨着高雄港，港区若受波及才会影响货运。影像判为整幅变化，沿海窗口海况噪声大，不是打击证据。
site_points.ctx_if_hit_en: A strike here would affect the navy's sorties, not any cargo chain; it adjoins Kaohsiung port, and only spill-over into the port area would touch freight. The imagery reads as whole-scene change, with sea-state noise in this coastal window, not evidence of a strike.

site_points.name: ching_chuan_kang_ab
site_points.ctx_where: 台湾台中，市区西北。
site_points.ctx_where_en: Taichung, Taiwan, north-west of the city.
site_points.ctx_what: 清泉岗基地：台湾中部最大的空军基地。
site_points.ctx_what_en: Ching Chuan Kang: the largest air base in central Taiwan.
site_points.ctx_if_hit: 打这里削弱台湾中部的空防出动能力，不在货物供应链上。影像判为整幅变化，季节所致；前后两景相隔 73 天。
site_points.ctx_if_hit_en: A strike here would weaken air-defence sorties from central Taiwan; it is not on any cargo chain. The imagery reads as whole-scene change, seasonal; the two scenes are 73 days apart.

site_points.name: taoyuan_airport
site_points.ctx_where: 台湾桃园。
site_points.ctx_where_en: Taoyuan, Taiwan.
site_points.ctx_what: 台湾最大的国际机场，晶圆和电子元件空运出口的主要口岸。
site_points.ctx_what_en: Taiwan's largest international airport, the main gateway for air-freighted wafer and component exports.
site_points.ctx_if_hit: 先进芯片主要走空运，这里关闭，台积电的出货就要改走高雄或海运；观察它是看有没有军事化或被封锁的迹象。
site_points.ctx_if_hit_en: Advanced chips mostly go by air; if it closes, TSMC shipments must divert to Kaohsiung or sea; watched for signs of militarisation or blockade.

site_points.name: pingtan_roro_port
site_points.ctx_where: 中国福建平潭，海峡西岸离台湾最近处。
site_points.ctx_where_en: Pingtan, Fujian, China, the point on the western shore nearest Taiwan.
site_points.ctx_what: 客滚码头，对台客运航线的出发点，也是被认为可用于登陆运输的滚装码头。
site_points.ctx_what_en: A ro-ro terminal, departure point for passenger routes to Taiwan and considered usable for landing transport.
site_points.ctx_if_hit: 列入观察是看有没有集结滚装船和车辆的迹象；它本身不在货物链上。
site_points.ctx_if_hit_en: Watched for signs of ro-ro ships and vehicles massing; not itself on any cargo chain.

site_points.name: hualien_ab
site_points.ctx_where: 台湾花莲，军民合用机场。
site_points.ctx_where_en: Hualien, Taiwan, a joint military and civil airfield.
site_points.ctx_what: 台湾东部的空军基地，与佳山洞库配套。
site_points.ctx_what_en: The air base of eastern Taiwan, paired with the Chiashan tunnel hangars.
site_points.ctx_if_hit: 不在供应链上；东部基地是西部机场被打后的备用。
site_points.ctx_if_hit_en: Not on any supply chain; the eastern bases are the fallback once western airfields are hit.

site_points.name: chiashan_ab
site_points.ctx_where: 台湾花莲，中央山脉东侧。
site_points.ctx_where_en: Hualien, Taiwan, on the eastern side of the Central Range.
site_points.ctx_what: 佳山基地：山体内的战机洞库，台湾空军在东部保存战机的地方；影像只看得见洞口与跑道。
site_points.ctx_what_en: Chiashan base: hangars dug into the mountain where Taiwan's air force shelters aircraft in the east; the imagery shows only the tunnel mouths and the runway.
site_points.ctx_if_hit: 它的用处是让战机在西部基地被打后还有地方藏身。影像判为整幅变化，季节与海况所致，不是打击证据。
site_points.ctx_if_hit_en: Its purpose is to keep aircraft sheltered after the western bases are struck. The imagery reads as whole-scene change, from season and sea state, not evidence of a strike.

site_points.name: magong_ab

reading: Taiwan Strait 在四百天窗口内没有触发断点规则；近七日日均 222.7 艘，窗口前一百八十天日均 227.3 艘，比值 0.98。
近十二个月有 37 家在美上市公司在申报文件里提到「Taiwan Strait」，共 67 件；提到不等于受影响，表里按收入列出前十家，作为公司级核查的起点。
以上每一句都只是数据窗口内的算术；原因、意图与下一步，本页不判断。
reading_en: Taiwan Strait did not trigger the break rule within the 400-day window; 7-day mean 222.7 ships, daily mean of the 180 days before the window 227.3 ships, ratio 0.98.

In the last twelve months 37 US-listed companies mentioned "Taiwan Strait" in their filings, 67 filings in all; a mention is not exposure; the table lists the top ten by revenue as the starting point for company-level checking.
Every sentence above is only arithmetic within the data window; cause, intent and what comes next, this page does not judge.

areas.note: 台湾最大的油气与集装箱港

reading.method_zh: 每条异常先对到最近的港口或锚地、算离岸距离，再按三条问：它在战前的常态里有没有解释；同一天同一处有没有别的船同样异常；船的身份（船旗、船名、有没有识别号）说明什么。判得出的写判断和依据，判不出的写为什么判不出。
reading.method_en: Each anomaly is first matched to the nearest port or anchorage and its distance from shore, then asked three things: is there an explanation in the pre-war pattern; are other ships anomalous at the same place on the same day; what does the ship's identity (flag, name, whether it has an ID) say. Where a judgement can be made it is written with its evidence; where not, the reason is stated.

taiwan.summary_zh: 台海这一天最要紧的是四处船数陡增全在台湾本岛的东北与东海岸外和澎湖以南，不在海峡主航道上：苏澳外 13 条船、台东外 7 条、澎湖以南 16 条、宁德外 4 条，同一天出现在平时几乎没船停的格子里，像是同一个原因让船离开常走的路去抛锚。是避风还是别的，本轮没有核到天气；台湾国防部 9 月 17 至 18 日通报共机 28 架次、共舰 7 艘，比前后几天略多，不到演习封海的量级。八条异常停留里一条伊朗旗货船停在海峡中间。
taiwan.summary_en: What matters most in the Taiwan area that day is that all four vessel-surge cells lie off the island's north-east and east coasts and south of Penghu, not on the strait's main lane: 13 ships off Su'ao, 7 off Taitung, 16 south of Penghu, 4 off Ningde, all appearing the same day in cells that normally hold almost no stopped ships, as if one cause sent ships off their usual routes to anchor. Whether it was weather or something else was not checked this round; Taiwan's defence ministry reported 28 PLA aircraft sorties and 7 ships for 17–18 September, slightly above the surrounding days and well short of an exercise closure. Among eight unusual stops, one Iranian-flagged cargo ship stopped in the middle of the strait.
items_zh: 船数陡增 4 格：苏澳外 31 公里（北纬 24.9 度，东经 121.8 度，宜兰外海）13 条船 121 船时，战前日均 1.8 船时，六十七倍；台东外海（北纬 22.6 度，东经 121.5 度，绿岛以北）7 条船 26 船时，二十九倍；澎湖以南 21 公里 16 条船 63 船时，九倍；宁德外 52 公里 4 条船 31 船时，十三倍。东北与东海岸外平时没有货船锚地，13 条船同一天在宜兰外海抛锚是本日最反常的一处。三处同日出现，最省事的解释是避风，但 9 月 17 到 18 日台湾附近有没有台风或强风，我这一轮没有核到；另一个可以核的解释是军事活动，台湾国防部通报 9 月 17 日 06 时到 18 日 06 时共机 28 架次（24 架次越过中线）、共舰 7 艘、公务船 2 艘，前一天 19 架次、后一天 20 架次，这一天偏多但不是演习封海的规模，海事局的航行警告里也没有台海的军事禁区通告。所以先记下：原因未定，两个候选都能核，下周核。

异常停留 8 条，有身份 7 条。最值得记的是伊朗旗货船「ABYAN」在海峡中部（北纬 24.4 度，东经 119.6 度，麦寮以西 89 公里、澎湖以北）停满 24 小时，这一格战前是零。伊朗货船出现在台海本身不常见，停一天更不常见；它的来路与去向要查逐日航迹，本轮没做。其余：塞拉利昂旗「HIN LEONG NO.1」在基隆东北 147 公里外海停 21 小时、坦桑尼亚旗「LYDIA 1」在基隆以北 82 公里停 19 小时、伯利兹旗「UNITED EARNING」在澎湖西南 92 公里停 20 小时，三条都是方便旗的小型货船停在远离港口的海上，与东岸那几处陡增同一天，可能是同一个原因；中国旗「雷盛 2」在湄洲湾外、「鸿隆 88」在厦门外、新加坡旗「LUCKY SOURCE」在宁德外，都是港外等泊。
信号中断 2 条：中国旗货船「金江盛」在平潭外中断 19 小时只移动 53 公里，折算 1.5 节，中断期间停过，再出现仍在平潭外，像是在近岸关了信号又开，或者近岸接收不到；台湾旗客船「亚曼尼 168 号」中断 18 小时移动 190 公里、5.7 节，从澎湖到台中港，是正常航行中的接收空档。两条都不作信号读。
没有偏离常走的路、没有停在陆上、没有远离航迹：台海这一天没有定位干扰的迹象。吕宋海峡框内 158 条船没有任何一类异常。
items_en: Vessel surges, 4 cells: 31 km off Su'ao (24.9 N, 121.8 E, off Yilan) 13 ships and 121 vessel-hours against a pre-war mean of 1.8 a day, 67 times; off Taitung (22.6 N, 121.5 E, north of Green Island) 7 ships, 29 times; 21 km south of Penghu 16 ships and 63 vessel-hours, 9 times; 52 km off Ningde 4 ships, 13 times. There is normally no cargo anchorage off the north-east and east coasts, and 13 ships anchoring off Yilan the same day is the day's most unusual reading. Three such places appearing at once are most simply explained by weather, but whether a typhoon or gale was near Taiwan on 17–18 September was not checked this round; the other checkable explanation is military activity: Taiwan's defence ministry reported 28 PLA aircraft sorties (24 crossing the median line), 7 ships and 2 official vessels for 06:00 17 September to 06:00 18 September, against 19 sorties the day before and 20 the day after, elevated but far from an exercise closure, and the Chinese maritime authorities' navigation warnings show no military exclusion zone in the strait. So: cause undetermined, both candidates checkable, to be checked next week.

Unusual stops, 8, of which 7 with identity. Most worth noting: the Iranian-flagged cargo ship 'ABYAN' stopped a full 24 hours in the middle of the strait (24.4 N, 119.6 E, 89 km west of Mailiao, north of Penghu), a cell with zero before the war. An Iranian cargo ship in the Taiwan Strait is uncommon in itself, stopping for a day more so; its origin and destination need its daily track, not done this round. The rest: Sierra Leone-flagged 'HIN LEONG NO.1' 147 km north-east of Keelung for 21 hours, Tanzania-flagged 'LYDIA 1' 82 km north of Keelung for 19 hours, Belize-flagged 'UNITED EARNING' 92 km south-west of Penghu for 20 hours, three small flag-of-convenience cargo ships stopped far from port on the same day as the east-coast surges, possibly for the same reason; Chinese-flagged 'LEI SHENG 2' off Meizhou Bay and 'HONG LONG 88' off Xiamen and Singapore-flagged 'LUCKY SOURCE' off Ningde are ordinary port waiting.

AIS gaps, 2: the Chinese-flagged cargo ship 'JIN JIANG SHENG' went silent 19 hours off Pingtan and moved only 53 km, 1.5 knots, so it stopped during the gap and reappeared still off Pingtan, either switching off and on near shore or out of reception near shore; the Taiwanese passenger vessel 'YA MAN NI NO.168' moved 190 km in 18 hours, 5.7 knots, from Penghu to Taichung, a reception gap while sailing normally. Neither is read as a signal.
No off-lane, none on land, none far from tracks: no sign of positioning interference in the Taiwan area that day. The Luzon Strait box, 158 ships, had no anomaly of any kind.

malacca.summary_zh: 马六甲这一天没有指向异常的信号。一处值得记：亚齐西岸外海（北纬 4.0 度，东经 96.0 度）六条散货船同一天各停满一天，那里不在航道上，战前没有船停；是等指令还是等货，本轮判不出。其余是新加坡西侧锚地、兰卡威的游艇和苏门答腊的内河。
malacca.summary_en: The Malacca area shows no signal that day. One item worth noting: six bulk carriers each stopped a full day off the west coast of Aceh (4.0 N, 96.0 E), off the lane and where no ship stopped before the war; whether they wait for orders or cargo cannot be told this round. The rest are the western Singapore anchorage, yachts at Langkawi and Sumatran rivers.
items_zh: 异常停留与船数陡增在亚齐西岸外重合：北纬 4.0 度、东经 96.0 度一格 6 条船 56 船时（基线 5.3，十倍），逐船看是马绍尔、巴拿马、孟加拉旗的散货船（「ARMONIA.GR」「GLOBAL HOPE」「YOUNG SPIRIT」「LYNUX INNOVATION」「TAN BINH 267」「GUL BANO」），其中「JOSCO GUIZHOU」（香港旗）与「ZOITSA SIGALA」（葡萄牙旗）各停 24 与 23 小时。这一片离最近的港口两百多公里，不在马六甲进出航道上，散货船成群在外海抛锚通常是等租约或等装港排期；判不出，下周看它们散了没有。
新加坡西侧、丹戎帕拉帕斯外 25 公里一格是同格并靠候选：韩国旗「CH CLARE」与「CH BELLA」各停 24 小时，同格还有 5 条各国货船。这一格是新加坡海峡西口的外锚地，两条同一船东的韩国货船一起等泊是常态，不作并靠读。
槟城以北的两格（兰卡威一带）船数陡增，逐船看是加拿大、英国、澳大利亚、圣马力诺旗的游艇，与波罗的海一样是游艇季，不算。
信号中断 3 条：两条是马来西亚与印尼旗的渡轮，折算航速不到一节，是近岸停靠；印尼旗货船「KM.BAHTERA CEMERLANG」21 小时 113 公里、2.9 节，慢速沿岸船，也不作信号读。停在陆上的 1 条在北纬 0.9 度、东经 102.0 度，是廖内的锡亚克河一带，内河航运。
对台海战区的意义：马六甲是东亚能源与原料进口的必经段，这一天没有阻断或改道的迹象；要看的数不是异常表，是总览页里马六甲咽喉点的通过量。
items_en: Unusual stops and a vessel surge coincide off the west coast of Aceh: one cell at 4.0 N, 96.0 E with 6 ships and 56 vessel-hours (baseline 5.3, ten times), per vessel bulk carriers under Marshall Islands, Panama and Bangladesh flags ('ARMONIA.GR', 'GLOBAL HOPE', 'YOUNG SPIRIT', 'LYNUX INNOVATION', 'TAN BINH 267', 'GUL BANO'), with 'JOSCO GUIZHOU' (Hong Kong) and 'ZOITSA SIGALA' (Portugal) stopped 24 and 23 hours. The spot is over two hundred kilometres from the nearest port and off the Malacca approach lanes; bulk carriers anchoring in a group offshore usually wait for charters or a loading slot; cannot be told, check next week whether they have dispersed.

West of Singapore, the cell 25 km off Tanjung Pelepas is a co-located candidate: the Korean-flagged 'CH CLARE' and 'CH BELLA' each stopped 24 hours, with 5 other cargo ships in the cell. This is the outer anchorage at the western entrance of the Singapore Strait; two Korean ships of one owner waiting together is routine, not read as a transfer.
Two surge cells north of Penang (around Langkawi) are, per vessel, yachts under Canadian, British, Australian and San Marino flags, the sailing season as in the Baltic; not counted.

AIS gaps, 3: two are Malaysian- and Indonesian-flagged ferries at under one knot implied, berthed near shore; the Indonesian cargo ship 'KM.BAHTERA CEMERLANG' moved 113 km in 21 hours, 2.9 knots, a slow coastal vessel, also not read as a signal. The 1 position on land at 0.9 N, 102.0 E is the Siak river area of Riau, river shipping.

For the Taiwan theater: Malacca is the passage every East Asian energy and raw-material import takes, and the day shows no sign of blockage or diversion; the number to watch is the Malacca chokepoint transit count on the overview page, not the anomaly table.

reading.conclusion_zh: 中东：没有指向新袭击的航迹信号。等着过霍尔木兹的船 7 月下旬到 8 月下旬翻倍、9 月稳在一百一十到一百三十条，一半以上等了一个月以上；上一版说科威特外海五十条船积压是误读，已改正；并靠不成立；一条无身份船在伊朗锡里岛与拉万岛两个原油码头之间关着信号往返，每周跟。黑海：多瑙河口的排队 8 月中旬起两周内从 10 条涨到 43 条，之后稳在 41 到 48 条，瓦尔纳没有同样的跳升；俄旗船 DONMASTER LEADER 黑海中央停一天，下周看去向。台海：东北与东海岸外三处同日船数陡增原因未定，避风与军事活动两个候选下周核；伊朗旗货船 ABYAN 海峡中部停一天，查航迹。波罗的海：异常大半是一二月基线碰上九月游艇季的假象，下周前换夏季基线；陆地轮廓要挖掉维纳恩湖与施莱湾。马六甲：无信号；亚齐西岸六条散货船成群抛锚，下周看散了没有。
reading.conclusion_en: Middle East: no track signal pointing to a new attack. Ships waiting to transit Hormuz doubled from late July to late August and hold at 110 to 130 in September, more than half waiting over a month; the earlier claim of fifty ships piling up off Kuwait was a misreading, now corrected; ship-to-ship transfer does not hold; one unidentified ship shuttles with its signal off between Iran's Sirri and Lavan crude terminals, followed weekly. Black Sea: the Danube-mouth queue rose from 10 to 43 ships within two weeks from mid-August and holds at 41 to 48, with no such jump off Varna; the Russian-flagged DONMASTER LEADER stopped a day mid-sea, to be followed next week. Taiwan: three same-day surges off the north-east and east coasts remain unexplained, weather and military activity to be checked next week; the Iranian-flagged ABYAN stopped a day mid-strait, track to be checked. Baltic: most anomalies are an artefact of a January–February baseline meeting the September sailing season; switch to a summer baseline before next week, and cut Lake Vänern and the Schlei out of the land outline. Malacca: no signal; six bulk carriers anchored in a group off western Aceh, check next week whether they dispersed.
